notes.title: Update R76: PvE Perks & Ranked PvP
notes.content:
Greetings, Shatterliners!

Are you ready for the biggest update since the Early Access launch? Here's Update R76.

[previewyoutube=O6xK6357Wus;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PVE PERKS[/h2]

In this update, we introduce a big change: operatives perks progression ladder in PvE. Each operative now has a unique progression of five PvE perks that will make your forays into higher-threat Expedition sectors a lot easier and more comfortable, and will ultimately enable you to reach further and further into the Zone and study its secrets. All perks work in PvE Episodes as well.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mDVTHmWv/Shatterline-Malva-perks.png[/img]

To climb the progression ladder, you will need to spend some resources that you extract from expeditions. There are five such new resources: Shards, Spores, Capacitors, Energy Cores, and Red Matter, and various progression perks will require you to spend a different combination and amounts of these resources.

[h2]EXPEDITION[/h2]

We are sure you would like to see more unique melee weapons in PvE. We start with Brisa, who now wields a beautiful and deadly Crystalline Katana, and Ram, with a mighty axe. Additionally, as a perk from the Operatives Expedition Progression, Strix may be equipped with a shield and hammer. From this release on, the unique melee weapons can also be used in PvE episodes.

We added a new encounter, the Gravity Tower, along with two new activities, two new dungeons, and new contracts. 

Other Expedition changes:
[list]
[*] The Contract and Main Goal rewards are now guaranteed and don't require a successful extraction.
[*] Now you can use refill points to detect the nearest dungeon in your vicinity if you acquire dungeon intel.
[*] Players can now locate and extract five unique resources needed to unlock Expedition progression levels.
[*] The Expedition win/lose screen also features your rewards and completed objectives.
[*] The amount of rewards for completing quests now depends on the threat level. The higher the threat, the bigger the reward.
[/list]

Several Expedition weapon keys were rebound:
[list]
[*] The dedicated melee weapon is now called by the "3" key (used to be bound to the long-pressed "v" key). Use the "Y" button on the game controller. 
[*] The power weapon is bound to the "4" key (used to be "3"). Press the D-pad down on the game controller.
[/list]


[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]Operatives balance tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Malva[/b]. The cool-down time of her ultimate ability, the Healing Station, increased. Hit points restored from the medi-spray decreased from 100 to 50.
[*] [b]Pill[/b]. The Crystalline Flamethrower's plasma now flies in a straight line. 
[*] [b]Brisa[/b]. Melee attacks do not decloak you anymore while the Tactical Cloak ability's cool-down time increased. The Glass Mine can now be thrown, similar to Kite's Remote Mine, and not just planted at your feet.
[*] [b]Kite[/b]. The Remote Mine's cool-down time increased.
[*] [b]Ram[/b] and [b]Strix[/b]. There is no cool-down timer anymore to use the exoskeleton speed boost ability. The ability works as stamina now, so you can use it unless the stamina is fully depleted. The HUD icon for this ability was overhauled. 
[/list]

[h3]Weapon balance tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]Dragonfly[/i] sniper rifle: damage in PvE increased by almost 75%.
[*] [i]Λ-3 Pilum[/i] assault rifle: accuracy decreased by 15% and aiming speed decreased two-fold.
[*] [i]Zenith[/i] assault rifle: the rate of fire decreased by 5% and stability decreased by 10%.
[*] [i]Tornado[/i] submachine gun: the effective distance increased by 15%, accuracy decreased by 15%, and the rate of fire increased slightly.
[*] [i]U22 Svarog[/i] revolver: the base damage in PvE at long range decreased by 15% while the PvE base damage at close range increased by 5%.
[*] [i]U44 Culverina[/i] revolver: the base damage in PvE at long range decreased by 25%.
[/list]

[h3]Weapon attachments tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] [i]HOLDEX[/i] magazine for the [i]Berlington TAC[/i] shotgun increases the reload speed by 20% (used to be 30%).
[*][i] Selenium ammo[/i] for the [i]XM-27 Pacifier[/i] assault rifle: the extra damage to Crystalline creatures tripled.
[*] [i]Selenium ammo[/i] for the [i]G9 Kungen[/i] and [i]G7 Springer[/i] pistols, [i]M2 Tactical SAS[/i] shotgun, [i]Tornado[/i] submachine gun, and [i]Λ-7 Ghost[/i] assault rifle: the extra damage to Crystalline creatures doubled.
[*] [i]Tungsten carbide bullets[/i] for the [i]G9 Kungen[/i] pistol and [i]Tungsten carbide pellets[/i] for the [i]R21 Brute[/i] shotgun: extra damage to Strafers doubled.
[*] [i]Combined receiver[/i] for the [i]G7 Springer[/i] pistol: after a precision kill, footstep sound volume is reduced by 80%  for 15 seconds (used to be 10 seconds).
[*] [i]Momentum booster[/i] for the [i]Λ-9 Legatus[/i] assault rifle: refills 20 rounds in magazine upon a slide kill (used to be 10 rounds).
[*] [i]Exploding mag[/i] (empty magazines explode upon reload) for the [i]R60 Gevaudan[/i] shotgun: explosion radius and damage were significantly increased.
[/list]


[h2]RANKED MATCHES[/h2]

The long-awaited and frequently-asked-for Ranked Matches have finally arrived!

[list]
[*] Please note that this is just the first iteration of Ranked Matches, therefore some things are basic, and others are missing for the moment as we want to test everything with you as soon as possible before moving forward. For instance, there is no leaderboard nor rank progression visualization on the match result screen.
[*] Ranked Matches are season based, and the duration of the first testing season is one month.
[*] Ranked Matches are played in Escort Mode featuring three maps: Escort, March, and Barracuda. The team size is 5v5.
[*] There are five leagues: [i]Bronze[/i], [i]Silver[/i], [i]Gold[/i], [i]Platinum[/i], and [i]Diamond[/i], each one consisting of four levels - from Level IV (the lowest) to Level I.
[*] The player starts with 300 ranked points and needs 1,000 points to progress to another level. The current rank points scheme is simple: 200 points for winning, minus 90 points for losing, and 50 points for ending a match with a draw. This scheme is a testing ground for the ranked matches and will be improved in the future.
[*] When you reach the [i]Silver[/i], [i]Gold[/i], or [i]Platinum League[/i], you won't roll back to the previous one. When you reach the [i]Diamond League[/i], you can roll back to the [i]Platinum[/i] one, but you will still have 3 lost-games protection.
[*] After progressing to each new league and after reaching Level I of the [i]Diamond League[/i], you will receive a special badge as a reward. The match rewards are increased by 20% for ranked matches in comparison with Versus matches.
[/list]

[h2]MISCELLANEOUS[/h2]

[list]
[*] When a player joins or leaves a game session, this information is displayed in the game chat.
[*] Two new seasonal tasks that will reward you with a unique nameplate and badge.
[*] Ram's Shellguard Visor cosmetic item had one small inherent issue. While being technically a headgear item, it combined a helmet and goggles, thus blocking the use of the face accessory slot. We resolved this by splitting the item into a separate helmet and goggles, so you may now use them in combination with each other or with other headgear or face accessory items. 
[*] We added audio for weapon inspection of [i]XM-40 Conciliator[/i], [i]Λ-3 Pilum[/i], [i]Λ-9 Legatus[/i], [i]Firespray[/i], [i]Λ-1 Centurion[/i], [i]U44 Culverina[/i], and [i]G7 Springer[/i].
[*] Twitch drops support was added.
[*] The Operatives Cosmetics Screen design was overhauled to be in line with the overall user interface design. When customizing your operative, you will see a separate screen where all the items are grouped into two categories: "All" and "Owned".
[/list]

New instant awards:
[list]
[*] [i]Air Defense[/i], for killing opponents who were mid-air (in a jump, for instance).
[*] [i]Bombs Go Boom[/i], for killing 10 Seeker Mines or Glass Hounds (aka Bomb Dogs) in PvE.
[*] [i]Eagle Eye[/i], for 3 headshot kills of snipers in PvE.
[*] Three instant awards for hip-fire kills: [i]Hip Killer[/i], for killing 5 opponents in PvE or 2 in PvP with hip fire, [i]No Scope[/i] (15 opponents in PvE or 5 in PvP), and [i]Hip Shooter[/i] (30 in PvE or 7 in PvP).
[/list]


[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash at match join.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where you could shoot through several boulders.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could reach non-playable areas.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get stuck at the entrance to the Strafer Vault.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where several trees were hanging in the air.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where Chosens' stashes could spawn half-buried in the ground, under Strafer Depots, or hanging in the air.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the operative's gear was present on the mission result screen as rewards.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the Crystalline Storm could enter the observatory building.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the air strike could happen inside a portal.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where Strafers in Sector Delta were spawning underground during extraction.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get stuck in a crystalline formation in the area next to the observatory dome.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the [i]Gomorrah[/i] weapon could be resupplied from the ammo drops from AIs.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where weapon skins were not applied to weapons in the match.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the first supply box didn't provide any primary weapon.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get through a concrete flower bed at the corner of the house on the rock, through boulders in the lava river, and through the edge of the roof of the building next to the parking lot.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could climb onto a void space that the destructed turret used to take. We also fixed an issue with several invisible objects on the Expedition map.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the Glasshead Nursery encounter could be completed without defeating the boss.
[*] Fixed issue on the March PvP map where a player could peak into an overpassing tube and kill an opponent who was there. We also fixed another issue on this map where Kite could get into a non-playable location by using the wall ability.
[*] Fixed issue with the "Smoke and Mirrors" task where the task description differed in the task description in the menu and the task itself.
[*] Fixed issue where the "Watch Them Burn" task didn't count the Lava Galassheads kills.
[*] Fixed issue where Pill's Stasis Field grenade could fail to freeze AIs under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed issue in the Armory where the weapon reload time didn't display the correct value when any attachment affecting the reload speed was equipped.
[*] Fixed issue where the equipped weapon perks or attachments didn't affect the weapon parameters on the Weapon Customization Screen.
[*] Fixed issue where the [i]Adrenaline Rush[/i] perk for the [i]Z-940 Drachen[/i] submachine gun had an epic perk icon instead of a legendary one.
[*] Fixed issue where the UI recent item icons were still present after purchased customization items were equipped on the preview screen.
[*] Fixed issue on the Island PvP map where Crystalline shards appeared when a player shot at the bush.
[*] Fixed issue where Ram's [i]Throwing Axe[/i] dealt only 10 damage to the Stilt and Queen bosses.
[*] Fixed issue with broken weapon selection animation after the use of the climbing ability by the Recon class.
[*] Fixed issue with quick melee animation which played twice if quick melee was used right after an attack with the [i]Tactical Kukri[/i].
[*] Fixed issue where players couldn't enter the Shooting Range if they left the squad after a game session.
[*] Fixed issue with broken Pill's drone animation in the game lobby after a player left a match and returned to the lobby. 
[*] Fixed issue where the operative figure in the lobby could become invisible when a player visited the Profile Info screen and returned back to the lobby.
[*] Fixed issue with the non-working [i]Smoke Mag[/i] weapon attachment.
[*] Minor localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Next week – Release 76.[/b] As promised before, the next huge Expedition update is almost here. What wasn’t exactly promised but was hinted at is the introduction of the Ranked PvP to Shatterline. We surprised ourselves a bit with how awesome our team is, as everyone came together and gave their extra time and energy to deliver competitive mode in this update.

[b]Ranked PvP, guys![/b] The time to test your skill has come. Truly test, you know. Finally! No mercy! Let the bloodbath... Well, you get the point.
Thanks to our competitive community and their restless leaders, regularly organizing Shatterline tournaments, we were able to gather much-needed data and feedback on how ranked games should feel and play. It helped us a lot in development, we are very grateful to all of you competitive enthusiasts out there!

We are rolling out our test run of Ranked games, to properly assess the feature and collect your feedback. It will last for one month, but the acquired badges will be permanent, as well as the 20% match rewards boost in Ranked compared to the regular Versus matches. So get out there and wreak some havoc.
The competitive arena's size is 5 versus 5. 
We’ll be playing Escort, with the 3 maps available: Escort, March, and Barracuda.
Five leagues: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond, each one consisting of four levels.
And we give out shiny badges for your efforts in climbing the ladder.

Our PvP scientists are racking their brains, doing the math behind the Ranked matches. We start simple. 
The current rank points scheme is 200 points for winning, minus 90 points for losing, and 50 points for ending a match with a draw. This is a testing ground for the ranked matches and will be adjusted in the future. 
A player starts with 300 ranked points and needs 1,000 points to progress to the following level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/73de8467789bd88da5a5effb533b397af91bfd88.png[/img]

[b]Expedition keeps getting new content and features. [/b]In this upcoming release, we are introducing hero progression as a part of the PvE experience, available in both Expedition and story missions, Episodes. 
All Shatterline operatives are getting PvE progression paths, acquiring new perks and abilities throughout their journey. The more you play one hero, the more new resources you haul from Expedition – the more diverse their gameplay becomes.

Each operative receives 5 branches of progression. Let’s have a look at what our favorite girl with magic hands, Malva, will look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/f64d6209a41620b129ab2b9818ee334a95a9cd2a.png[/img]

Malvas around the world will be giving more focus on healing their teammates, as it’s becoming more beneficial to both parties with a part of the healing applied to allies now also coming back to Malva herself. 
Healing applied also benefits our loyal Pinscher Drone, which stands on guard with a progression path of its own and becomes stronger further down the path. Don’t forget to take care of the Drone too, as Malva can now support her companion, healing it and making sure it grows healthy and deadly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/3d9fb08c7e77f2cc76cf3218b18bd0306b204870.png[/img]

[b]We are experimenting with more fun stuff to add to the game[/b], and here’s just a tiny sneak peek into one little thing currently tested behind the scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/6ca615be7f83addd9c476560a0c641668e503baf.gif[/img]

[b]Twitch Drops are coming[/b] with this update! Look out for the Shatterline streams on Twitch with enabled drops, as we’ve finished the preparations and are ready to roll out rewards for your support of Shatterline creators.
Just last month we implemented a Support-a-Creator system into the game store. We’ve done this in collaboration with our partner [b]Nexus.gg[/b]. Support your favorite ones!



[b]And while we are all here – here is an XP boost for you.
[/b]
[b]GIVEMEXPDELTA[/b]

[list]
[*] Copy this code, head over to Shatterline in-game store, and click Redeem Code button in the bottom right corner.
[*] Paste the code in the pop-up window and click Apply.
[*] Now you have a 100% XP boost for the following 2 days. 
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update R75: Season Delta
notes.content:
Hi there! 

Season Delta is finally here along with interesting changes and improvements in Update R75.

[previewyoutube=AL2Em7Ijxm4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]SEASON DELTA[/h3]

Please welcome a new game season: Season Delta. As always, complete new tasks and get your cool rewards.


[h3]CRAFTING STATION[/h3]

Weapon modifications that you crafted during the previous seasons have been split into two separate entities: the weapon perks and the weapon skins, while the weapon modification as a combination of a weapon perk and unique visuals is a thing of the past. That means that now you can apply the perk to the base weapon with or without any skin. It also means that from now on the crafting station will provide a random weapon perk, not a weapon modification. In Season Delta, in addition to all the previous season's perks, the crafting station furnishes 7 new perks bundled with either epic or legendary weapon skins.

[list]
[*] [i]Range Boost[/i] perk for the [i]XM-27 Pacifier[/i] bundled with the Pacifier Shatterline weapon skin: a 10%-increase in damage beyond the effective range.
[*] [i]Sprint-to-Fire Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Lupara Compatta[/i] bundled with the Lupara Renaissance weapon skin: the sprint-to-fire delay is reduced by 15%.
[*] [i]Precision Damage Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Berlington TAC[/i] bundled with the TAC Antique weapon skin:  precision damage is increased by 10%.
[*] [i]Magazine Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Tornado [/i]bundled with the Tornado Mural weapon skin: 5 additional ammo in the magazine.
[*] [i]Speed Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Z-940 Drachen[/i] bundled with the Drachen Renaissance weapon skin: 15% faster sprint-to-fire transition and 5% faster aiming down sights speed.
[*] [i]ADS Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Presarm VX-7[/i] bundled with the VX-7 Bloodstream weapon skin: the movement speed while aiming is increased by 10%.
[*] [i]ADS Boost[/i] perk for the [i]SAG-8 Reaper [/i]bundled with the Reaper Renaissance weapon skin: the movement speed while aiming is increased by 15%.
[/list]


[h3]EXPEDITION[/h3]

[list]
[*] Upon successful extraction, your weapons, abilities, and a random perk of the highest rarity will be stashed for use on your next Expedition. This extracted gear is available in a special extraction stash deployed near the LZ at the session start. The items in the stash are replaced with newly extracted ones next time.
[*] Bi-directional zip lines were added across the map.
[*] The spawn rate of the Lightning Anomaly decreased considerably.
[*] The movement speed with the Tactical Kukri increased.
[*] Many a player stumbled upon the issue that two or three players couldn't use the supply drop simultaneously: if several players pressed "E" at the same moment, only one could successfully open the box. We improved this logic, and now all players can open the box at the same time. Overall, the vast majority of issues with non-working supply bins were fixed.
[*] Improved matchmaking for Expedition. On the Expedition Mode info screen, you can tell the matchmaking system that you want to play with players interested in the same aspects of the game as you, choosing among specific threat levels and dungeons as search criteria. The matchmaking system will try to match you with like-minded players. The Expedition Mode info screen also features an updated rewards list.
[*] At threat level 3 or more, you may encounter a modified Glasshead enemy.
[*] Improved visuals, animation, video, and sound effects for various activities. 
[*] We fixed a critical issue in Expedition which caused many boss encounters never to spawn. Therefore, the variability of boss encounters will increase substantially after the fix.
[*] The activities rewards were rebalanced in accordance with the time spent to complete the activity. While the Red Salt amount decreased, so did the cost of calling a supply drop and the decontaminator use. The Red Salt rewards from secret stashes also decreased, but the salt/seasonal xp conversion ratio increased five-fold.
[/list]


[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]

Pill's drone's resurrection algorithm was improved. Before, the drone always resuscitated the closest fallen friendly. Now it checks for enemies and whether they have an open line of sight to the friendly in need of revival and then resuscitates the friendly whom it calculated the safest for revival.

Malva's Pinscher Drone will teleport to its owner if the distance between them exceeds 70 meters or if it cannot get to its owner, excluding the situation when Malva is on a zip-line.  


[h3]MISCELLANEOUS[/h3]

Social panel improvements:
[list]
[*] The "Leave Squad" button was added to the squad submenu.
[*] Pop-up messages for the squad leader and squad members after when they want to exit the game session, offering the leader to leave the game with the squad, alone, or cancel, and offering a squad member to either leave the squad or cancel.
[*] A new notification bubble on the social button (the one under your name badge to the right) that indicates a new friend or squad invitation.
[*] A search field under your friends submenu.
[*] Squad list sorting was introduced. Now you will see your squad leader on top, then yourself, and then all other squad members.
[*] Squad Requests and Friend Requests categories were added. 
[/list]

Ten new instant awards:
[list]
[*] [i]Facepalm[/i]: activate your ultimate, but fail to score any kills (doesn't work for Malva).
[*] [i]Sneaky Kill[/i]: As Brisa, perform 2 kills in PvP or 5 in PvE while cloaked.
[*] [i]Trapped & Bound[/i]: As Brisa, perform a kill with the Glass Mine.
[*] [i]Healing Vibe[/i]s: As Malva, restore 50 hitpoints in PvE or 25 in PvP with the Healing Station.
[*] [i]Bite, Boy[/i]: As Malva, get 10 PvE or 3 PvP pinscher drone kills.
[*] [i]Ram Bam Bam[/i]: As Ram, perform 1 gravity strike kill in PvP or 5 in PvE.
[*] [i]Thunderclap[/i]: As Ram, perform 5 ultimate kills in PvP or 10 in PvE.
[*] [i]Robo-Nurse[/i]: As Pill, perform 2 revives with the drone in PvP or 5 in PvE. Self-resurrects do not count.
[*] [i]All-Seeing Eye[/i]: As Orbit, detect 3 hostiles in PvP or 6 in PvE with a drone.
[*] [i]Mr. Hyde[/i]: As Orbit, kill 4 enemies with the ultimate in PvP or 8 in PvE.
[/list]

Other important changes:
[list]
[*] New players will never be added to an ongoing match.
[*] Game Store improvement: after purchasing a bundle, you can now view and equip the bundle items on your operatives and weapons without leaving the bundle screen.
[*] When your weapons or characters reach their maximum progression level, the progress bar in the Armory and on the Operatives screen will have "MAX" written on its right end to inform you that your weapon or operative is maxed out.
[*] Sounds in the PvP Domination mode were improved and became louder. We also improved the sliding sound effects and added ambient sounds in the Barracuda PvP map.
[*] Players who are launching Expedition and haven't completed the Intro Mission will be prompted by a one-time pop-up message to play it before plunging into Expedition.
[/list]


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed game crash at the Research Station encounter cinematic in Expedition.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get loot from a supply drop multiple times.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a regular supply box appeared at the Strafer Outpost instead of a gold one.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where unpicked items from a previously opened supply box would reappear in the next supply box if the next one was opened for the second time.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where players could not get the Gomorrah weapon from the Chosens' stash.
[*] Fixed audio issues during Expedition's Sample Extraction encounter.
[*] Fixed issue where the Expedition: Butcher task could be completed in any PvE mode, not Expedition exclusively.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition's Horror Maze where the player caught by the Chaser was teleported to the spawn point even if the Chaser had been killed by a teammate. 
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where Malva's Pinscher Drone attacked AIs affected by the Strife perk.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition with incorrect physics of one of the rooftops in the village area.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get to a non-playable area on top of the Strafer Vault and get stuck there.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a secondary objective could be activated during an active encounter with a sector boss.
[*] Fixed issues in Expedition where a player could get stuck on the map.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with Kite's remote mine. 1) We fixed the issue where it wouldn't detonate if pressing the remote button had been interrupted during the previous instance of the remote mine use. 2) We also fixed another issue with Kite's remote mine where the mine plant icon turned into the detonator icon and stayed this way when Kite was killed before he could trigger the mine and he spawned back into session. 3) And finally, we fixed the issue where the ability icon showed the detonation button instead of the ability cooldown progress if the mine had been destroyed mid-air right after being thrown. 
[*] Fixed issue with missing visual effects when an enemy was trapped in Brisa's mine.
[*] Fixed issue where the Gardener AI could spawn invisible for the first time or become invisible after the player rejoined the session during the last checkpoint.
[*] Fixed issue where an enemy operative could become invisible (entirely or partly).
[*] Fixed issue with missing reload animation of the TWD X-Treme sniper rifle.
[*] Fixed issue where an operative was hanging mid-air during the last cutscene of the Sunken Lab PvE episode.
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect hand position on the Λ-1 Centurion equipped with the CLAW FP and GS CQBL-12M attachments.
[*] Fixed issue with reload animation in the weapon inspection mode for the SAG-8 Reaper equipped with the GB-39M Handyman or Birusa-M attachments where the operative's hand didn't move at weapon reload.
[*] Fixed issue where no inertia was applied to the dead body if the target had been moving before being killed.
[*] Fixed issue with the Momentum Booster attachment for the XM-27 Pacifier assault rifle where it added bullets beyond the magazine capacity.
[*] Fixed issue in the Border Control episode where some Seeker Mines were invisible and another issue where a player could get stuck in physics at the edge of the building at the beginning of the mission.
[*] Fixed issue with the smoke grenade where the opponent could see the person who was exiting the smoke before the smoke effect dissipated for the person moving through the smoke.
[*] Fixed issues on the Barracuda map where the water textures could flicker intensely in the dock area, where Malva's medkits fell under terrain when dropped into the stream, and where players could get to a non-playable area. 
[*] Fixed issue where the Captain Buzzkill task didn't count Orbit's drones.
[*] Fixed issue for Strix and Ram where the weapon items changed from one to another when the player was moving forward and pressed the SHIFT and CTRL keys at the same time.
[*] Fixed issue with the R60 Gevaudan shotgun where the weapon position on the screen was much lower in comparison with other shotguns.
[*] Fixed issue where the longest kill streak and the most kills per session displayed zero values on the personal statistics screen.
[*] Fixed issue with the personal statistics screen where statistics for some weapons didn't count correctly.
[*] Fixed issue where the game could freeze on laptops when the player alt-tabbed out and back into the game run in the Fullscreen mode.
[*] Fixed issue on the Escort map where the defender's spawn point near the tobacco shop could be easily camped.
[*] Fixed issue on the CQB PvP map where a player could see through one of the shipping containers if standing close to it.
[*] Fixed issue where the dash ability progress bar filled up faster than the operative could in fact use the ability.
[*] Fixed issue with Ram character customization where players could not change headgear or face style if Skull Helmet or Shellguard Visor had been equipped before.
[*] Fixed issue on the Nisida PvP maps where Orbit could get to a non-playable area using his dash ability.
[*] Fixed issue where the Game Set & Match task could not be completed in the 3 vs 3 game mode.
[/list]

tags.feature: Weapon modifications that you crafted during the previous seasons have been split into two separate entities: the weapon perks and the weapon skins, while the weapon modification as a combination of a weapon perk and unique visuals is a thing of the past. That means that now you can apply the perk to the base weapon with or without any skin. It also means that from now on the crafting station will provide a random weapon perk, not a weapon modification. In Season Delta, in addition to all the previous season's perks, the crafting station furnishes 7 new perks bundled with either epic or legendary weapon skins.

tags.balance_change: [i]Range Boost[/i] perk for the [i]XM-27 Pacifier[/i] bundled with the Pacifier Shatterline weapon skin: a 10%-increase in damage beyond the effective range.
[i]Sprint-to-Fire Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Lupara Compatta[/i] bundled with the Lupara Renaissance weapon skin: the sprint-to-fire delay is reduced by 15%.
[i]Precision Damage Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Berlington TAC[/i] bundled with the TAC Antique weapon skin: precision damage is increased by 10%.
[i]Magazine Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Tornado [/i]bundled with the Tornado Mural weapon skin: 5 additional ammo in the magazine.
[i]Speed Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Z-940 Drachen[/i] bundled with the Drachen Renaissance weapon skin: 15% faster sprint-to-fire transition and 5% faster aiming down sights speed.
[i]ADS Boost[/i] perk for the [i]Presarm VX-7[/i] bundled with the VX-7 Bloodstream weapon skin: the movement speed while aiming is increased by 10%.
[i]ADS Boost[/i] perk for the [i]SAG-8 Reaper [/i]bundled with the Reaper Renaissance weapon skin: the movement speed while aiming is increased by 15%.

tags.feature: Upon successful extraction, your weapons, abilities, and a random perk of the highest rarity will be stashed for use on your next Expedition. This extracted gear is available in a special extraction stash deployed near the LZ at the session start. The items in the stash are replaced with newly extracted ones next time.
Bi-directional zip lines were added across the map.

tags.balance_change: The spawn rate of the Lightning Anomaly decreased considerably.
The movement speed with the Tactical Kukri increased.

tags.bug: Many a player stumbled upon the issue that two or three players couldn't use the supply drop simultaneously: if several players pressed "E" at the same moment, only one could successfully open the box. We improved this logic, and now all players can open the box at the same time. Overall, the vast majority of issues with non-working supply bins were fixed.

tags.feature: Improved matchmaking for Expedition. On the Expedition Mode info screen, you can tell the matchmaking system that you want to play with players interested in the same aspects of the game as you, choosing among specific threat levels and dungeons as search criteria. The matchmaking system will try to match you with like-minded players. The Expedition Mode info screen also features an updated rewards list.
At threat level 3 or more, you may encounter a modified Glasshead enemy.
Improved visuals, animation, video, and sound effects for various activities.

tags.bug: We fixed a critical issue in Expedition which caused many boss encounters never to spawn. Therefore, the variability of boss encounters will increase substantially after the fix.

tags.balance_change: The activities rewards were rebalanced in accordance with the time spent to complete the activity. While the Red Salt amount decreased, so did the cost of calling a supply drop and the decontaminator use. The Red Salt rewards from secret stashes also decreased, but the salt/seasonal xp conversion ratio increased five-fold.

tags.feature: Pill's drone's resurrection algorithm was improved. Before, the drone always resuscitated the closest fallen friendly. Now it checks for enemies and whether they have an open line of sight to the friendly in need of revival and then resuscitates the friendly whom it calculated the safest for revival.
Malva's Pinscher Drone will teleport to its owner if the distance between them exceeds 70 meters or if it cannot get to its owner, excluding the situation when Malva is on a zip-line.
The "Leave Squad" button was added to the squad submenu.

Pop-up messages for the squad leader and squad members after when they want to exit the game session, offering the leader to leave the game with the squad, alone, or cancel, and offering a squad member to either leave the squad or cancel.

notes.title: Update R74
notes.content:
It's time for a monthly update, Shatterliners!

Here's what it has brought.

[previewyoutube=dXaluEql-5s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Expedition tweaks and changes[/h3]

A new Sector Boss encounter: the Glasshead Nursery. Think a Gardener is bad enough? Well, hold his beer while he morphs into an Uber Gardener! Shut down the Nursery before more Gardeners can spawn.

Activities improvements:
[list]
[*] World activities will no longer spawn in neighboring positions.
[*] Activity rewards were rebalanced to avoid situations when some activities were ignored due to their lower rewards.
[*] The Locked Tower activity has become easier to complete.
[/list]

Five new perks:
[list]
[*] Chain Lightning: gives a chance to discharge a bolt of chain lightning upon kill.
[*] Salty Shot: the enemies have a chance to drop some Red Salt upon death.
[*] Explosive Precision: the enemies killed with precision shots have a chance to explode.
[*] Automatic Reloader: the active weapon will reload upon ammo pickup.
[*] Healing Ammo: heals the player upon ammo pickup.
[/list]

When you collect Red Salt, it converts into seasonal XP at once so that you may extract all of it in the end.

Seasonal XP is now displayed on your HUD along with other resources.

Contracts now reward you with two Blueprints instead of one. Furthermore, they provide you with seasonal XP instead of credits.


[h3]We increased the regeneration speed in PvE[/h3] 

The most noticeable increase is for Segment 2 of the health bar, especially when you walk. Regeneration speed when you run increased for all the segments.

[h3]Weapon balance tweaks[/h3]

Upon careful study of the game data and players' feedback, we saw that some weapons were in need of rebalancing.

[list]
[*] [b][i]XM-27 Pacifier[/i][/b] assault rifle: the rate of fire decreased by 7%. The [i]D-AR ARMAG M5[/i] enhanced capacity magazine now reduces weapon stability by 15% instead of aiming speed.
[*] [i][b]Zenith[/b][/i] assault rifle: The [i]AK-RPK 101[/i] enhanced capacity magazine reduces reload time by 20% instead of 15% and reduces aiming speed by 10%.
[*][i][b] XM-40 Conciliator[/b][/i] assault rifle: the rate of fire increased by 7%.
[*] [i][b]Λ-9 Legatus[/b][/i] assault rifle: the base damage decreased by 10% at mid-range and by 25% at long-range.
[*] [i][b]Presarm VX-7[/b][/i] sniper rifle: The [i]AM4 MAG[/i] enhanced capacity magazine reduces reload time by 20% instead of 15% and reduces aiming speed by 15%. 
[*] [i][b]G7 Springer pistol[/b][/i]: the base damage at effective distance was slightly decreased. The MZ-09 E extended magazine reduces reload time by 20% instead of 10%.
[*] [i][b]Black Falcon II[/b][/i] shotgun: accuracy decreased by 20%.
[*] [i][b]R21 Brute[/b][/i] shotgun: the rate of fire decreased by 10% while stability decreased considerably due to a new recoil pattern.
[*] [i][b]Berlington TAC[/b][/i] shotgun: accuracy during movement decreased by around 15%.
[*] [i][b]Λ-1 Centurion[/b][/i] submachine gun: the rate of fire decreased by 5%, stability decreased by 10%, and accuracy decreased by 10%.
[*] [i][b]G5 Earl[/b][/i] pistol: the base damage at effective distance slightly decreased.
[*] [i][b]U22 Svarog[/b][/i] and [i][b]U44 Culverina[/b][/i]: In PvE, revolvers have not only got considerable base damage and precision damage boost, but they can also pierce the opponents and deal damage, albeit reduced, to a target behind the pierced one.
[/list]

[h3]PvP Escort Mode tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] The escorted payload got a new visual on the Barracuda map, and this new payload has no Bomb Dogs nested in it.
[*] Both the Barracuda payload and the old-style payload on the rest of the Escort mode maps got their movement speed tweaked: the maximum speed decreased by 20%.
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fourteen new kill reactions for Strafer AIs were added.
[*] Сontroller aim assist changes: we improved the aim assist behavior, changed the aim assist presets, and added the aim assist strength as a separate user option.
[*] Minor Player's Profile Screen tweaks: we added the Edit Badge button in the upper-left corner and changed the playtime units of measurement from "days, hours, minutes" to just hours.
[*] Improved Score Board looks. We also added the party and party leader indicators.
[*] PvE Episodes and Blitz missions are now within a single playlist, and the available mission changes every hour.
[/list]

Animation improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved synchronization of AI animation.
[*] Smoother animation for various interactions with objects, including the recon class climbing, rearming at the ammo crates, and interacting with movable boxes, bins, and vehicles.
[*] Improved animation of the Environment Scanner.
[/list]


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Crash fixes.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the Crystalline Storm could damage players inside buildings or under the ground.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the Strife perk icon disappeared if the player looked at the affected AI through a zoomed-in weapon.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a sample couldn't be picked up any longer if it had been dropped by a player mid-jump.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the dead player failed to teleport to the next zone.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where an extraction point could spawn onto a supply drop.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where a canister that couldn't be picked up might appear in one of the maze rooms.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the mission sounds could be played during the reward screen sequence.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the Esc-menu's list of perks overlapped with the mode description text.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the electromagnetic beam turrets could spawn at unreachable locations.
[*] Tweaked Gunslinger task localization where sidearm kills were changed to pistol kills since this subtask doesn't count the kills from the Lupara shotgun sidearm.
[*] Fixed issue with an unnaturally bent Orbit's arm when he was preparing to throw the Swarm Grenade, as observed by other players.
[*] Fixed issue with Ram's axes where they could stay hanging in the air near movable objects when thrown at them.
[*] Fixed issue with the Sheriff Holster attachment for the U22 Svarog revolver where the perk reactivated after the quick melee attack.
[*] Fixed issue with Pill's med drone where it was continuously trying to teleport to its owner when Pill was using a zip line.
[*] Fixed issue in the Invasion mode where Ram could skip the first and second objectives.
[*] Fixed issue in the Cyber Trail PvE mission where some Seeker Mines were invisible during the metro tunnel encounter.
[*] Fixed issue with a glitchy reload animation of the Dragonfly sniper rifle.
[*] Fixed issue where Malva's hair would become pitch-black at low graphics settings.
[*] Fixed issue where Mongoose's grenade launcher slightly twitched after each shot.
[*] Fixed issue with Kite's remote mine placed on a movable object where the mine dropped on the ground if the object was kicked or moved; but for a new player who connected to the match after this, the mine was hanging mid-air.
[*] Fixed issue with stickers on the R60 Gevaudan shotgun where the sticker placement was different in the first-person and in the third-person view (the point of view of other players).
[*] Fixed exploit on the Deathlab PvP map where a player could climb onto an area not designed to be reachable.
[*] Fixed issue on the Nisida PvP map where there was a hazard zone where it shouldn't be.
[*] Fixed issue where the character left shoulder animation was broken when the player was carrying crystalline batteries in Expedition and changed direction abruptly.
[*] Fixed issue with the Momentum Booster attachment for the SAG-8 Reaper sniper rifle where the attachment allowed the player to shoot twice without reloading.
[*] Fixed issue where a party of six players could queue for a 3 v 3 match and never find a match, obviously. 
[*] Fixes for minor visual issues on Metro, Escape, Nisida, and Barracuda PvP maps, in Hecatomb and Twin Stilts PvE episodes, and the Sunken Lab Blitz mission.
[*] Fixed issue with the Bloodlust loader attachment for the Berlington TAC shotgun where the attachment failed to work on AI enemies.
[*] Fixed issue in the Twin Stilts PvE mission where unstable samples, if dropped, didn't disappear after a timeout. 
[*] Fixed issue where the AI weak points could stay on the ground after the body had disappeared if the AI was killed not in its weak point.
[*] Fixed issue with the minimap where sometimes minimap icons could get stuck at its center.
[*] Fixed issue with the XM-27 Pacifier's Executor muzzle break didn't work.
[*] Fixed issue where Brisa's trap mine's spikes could get invisible upon the mine's activation.
[*] Fixed issue where Kite's crystalline revolver icon could show the ability was available when in fact it was depleted. This happened if Kite died when using the ultimate ability and was resurrected by a teammate.
[*] Fixed issue on the March PvP map where one of the overhead pipes exits was blocked by an invisible wall.
[*] Fixed issue on the Escort PvP map where a player could get on top of the traffic signpost.
[*] Fixed issue in the Twin Stilts PvE episode where the player's icon was displayed under terrain when the player entered the portal.
[*] Fixed localization issue where the description of the Sure Shot task failed to indicate it was PvP only.
[*] Fixed issue with artifacts of Malva's Basic Medic Suit during cut-scenes.
[*] Fixed issue with the TA-12 red dot sight for the Λ-9 Legatus assault rifle where the 10% faster aiming-down-sight speed applied only after two seconds of aiming; and with the Farsight Prism red dot sight for the Zenith and Λ-7 Ghost assault rifles where the 10% faster sprint-to-fire transition also applied after 2 seconds of aiming.
[*] Fixed issue with the Executor attachment for the XM-27 Pacifier and the Weight Rebalance attachment for the Λ-7 Ghost didn't work.
[*] Fixed issue with the Gunstream Z-54 red dot sight for the Z-940 Drachen submachine gun where the attachment changed the general weapon's field of view instead of the FOV when aiming down sights.
[*] Fixed issue where the tip of the weapons equipped with the iron sight moved too much in relation to the weapon's butt when the player quickly moved the weapon while aiming down sights.
[*] Fixed issue where the Versus the World task was too hard to complete.
[*] Fixed issue with a shaky animation toward the end of the Zangor Impala sniper rifle's inspection.
[*] Fixed issue in the Sunken Lab Blitz mission where the text warning of a hazard area was missing in the lab.
[*] Fixed issue where movable objects could get in front of players and hide them on the Most-Valued-Players screen.
[*] Fixed issue in Expedition where the electromagnetic beam turrets could spawn at unreachable locations.
[*] As some fixes in Patch 73.3 failed to work, we rechecked them in Update R74 and we confirm they work properly:
[*] • Fixed issue in Expedition where the players were shown on the ground for a split second before the cinematic clip with deployment.
[*] • Fixed issue in Expedition where the Shady contract could be completed by itself, without players' doing anything to this end.
[*] • Fixed issue in Expedition where the requested supplies could be dropped in the area where the players had come from.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Until now we were trying to keep you informed on what’s going on with Shatterline and FragLab in a series of posts from the development team, and we realized - that’s just not enough!
So with this Community Update #1, we are starting a fine tradition of regular updates, where we gather as much news and sneak peeks into the development process as possible! 


[b]This week – release R74.[/b] Some cool new stuff is coming with the regular monthly update this week. Expedition gets a new Sector Boss encounter: the Glasshead Nursery, where Gardener turns into an uber version of himself.
We increased the regeneration speed in PvE. The most noticeable increase is for Segment 2 of the health bar, especially when walking. New perks, weapon balance tweaks; please read the release notes to find out about all the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/90404115e46307289d8b16b296159cb5711f7e44.gif[/img]


[b]Next up is the second phase of Expedition rework.[/b] Our first phase of Expedition rework happened. It is not the last one, and we are preparing two more big updates to complete the rework.
In the next, second, update we will be introducing a new progression loop for all our Operatives. Every playable character is getting a set of perks, gradually unlocked while playing and leveling them up. With this second big change, we want to add more depth to the Operatives and the way you play them. More options in playstyles – more fun! 
Let’s have a sneak peek at the new Brisa, brought to her ultimate form, with all the character perks unlocked. These perks will be available in Expedition only, for now, and all of them are still in development, so some changes down the road are to be expected. 

Brisa is turning into a dangerous enemy to every glasshead out there. On top of Brisa’s current skillset, allowing her to efficiently maneuver between long-distance and close-quarters playstyles, she is now able to inflict additional damage over time while using a sniper rifle. With the right choice of weaponry to maximize her bleed damage output, she can stack it up, rush into close range, and instantly trigger all the bleeds she applied with just one hit of the melee weapon. If cloaked while doing it, she will also instantly recharge a third of her Invisibility Cloak cooldown, making it easier to hide back in the shadows and stay alive in dangerous situations. This is only one scenario among many possibilities we are sure you will come up with while playing!
Oh, and more types of melee weapons are coming too, so we hope you will have a fun time choosing how exactly to punish everyone who dared to give Brisa a side-eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/e3f4ace73a940f2e07d69fae26cbb90bb74216a9.jpg[/img]
Want to know what to expect from other Operatives? We can share a bit. Pill will become a lucky looter and a very generous one at that. Malva is becoming an altruistic and angsty support, able to heal and deal damage with the wave of the hand. Strix… Is all about shields!


[b]The battle pass experience[/b] is being carefully reviewed by the design team during this Season Charlie. Seasons Alpha and Bravo, in their own ways, showed us that completing a battle pass in one week is not much fun. In Season Charlie we tried increasing the experience required for a new battle pass level. 
Data and your feedback are showing that some players might have a difficult time leveling up battle pass this time, and we are looking into providing more meaningful ways to earn the battle pass experience. One of the solutions we are working on right now is making tasks friendlier and easier to complete.


[b]We are having a battle pass XP boosters giveaway[/b] this week. Head over to [url=https://discord.com/invite/shatterline]our Discord[/url], and use a command [i]/givemexp[/i] in the event channel. Redeem the code in the in-game store before the end of Season Charlie and you'll receive a 100% XP boost, which will last for 2 days.
While grabbing your booster, have a look at the [b]Meme Contest[/b] going on this month. Submit your Shatterline meme for a chance to win a hefty sum of in-game gold! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757252/5601300bd2640b61d4fd40c0370097c7715fcb89.gif[/img]
[i]by Discord user ᴛᴇᴇᴡʜʏ#3410[/i]


[b]We continue to improve[/b] ourselves and are learning to work better as an independent studio, keeping you in the loop of what’s going on with and around Shatterline. Along with the community updates we are preparing the developers' live streams, where players can ask questions and play Shatterline with us. We are putting a lot of time and effort into making sure the player feedback is heard, meticulously gathering it on our social platforms, and triaging within the team.
Please join the conversation in [url=https://discord.com/invite/shatterline]our Discord forums[/url] and let us know how we are doing and where we can do better!

notes.title: Update R73: New Expedition
notes.content:
Hi there, Shatterliners!

We are happy to present you with another big update in two months. And the changes are big!

[previewyoutube=kubEYxc0zyI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]EXPEDITION[/h3]

Back in January, we announced that Shatterline needed some more work and fine-tuning before it was ready for release. One of the game’s key features is, of course, Expedition, and we brought our primary attention to it to make it a real crown jewel of the game. 

So here we are, two months past, to present you with our first iteration of the all-new Expedition. Kindly note that this is a work in progress, and we will expand on what you will see in the present update.

In revisiting Expedition, we focused on the exploration aspect, putting the player’s choice of what to do first, thus making Expedition a non-linear experience with diversified gameplay and high replayability.  

What changed? Well, a lot. We won't spill out all the beans here, but here are the key changes.

1. The map is now divided into four sectors, each one having a different Threat Level ranging from 1 to 4. The Threat Level governs the number of hostiles and their deadliness, and the starting sector always has Threat Level 1. 

No worries: the Contamination Levels are still there to make your expedition in the Zone anything but a cakewalk.

2. It’s for you to decide what to do in the sector or whether to proceed to another one. To identify what to explore, you have a nifty tool: the Environment Scanner, which scans the surrounding area for activities you may engage in for different rewards. Such activities include Dungeon Clearances, Sector Bosses, Contracts, etc. 

3. Supply Drops are no longer a given thing: it is now your option to call for them via Mule Communicators, special communication devices scattered around the map. But to do that you need to spend some Red Salt. 

What’s the Red Salt you ask? Besides the fact that its collection is the primary objective of Shellguard’s expeditions into the Zone (as the Red Salt is the backbone for those cool special abilities and weapons Shellguard operatives use), it is the in-Zone currency you may either spend on Supply Drops or carry with you by extracting from Expedition and convert it into Season Pass progression points.

4. When exploring the Zone, you may stumble upon Secret Stashes where you can find blueprints, game credits, and Chosen weapons. These stashes are not visible on the Environmental Scanner. 

5. There is a dedicated melee weapon: the Tactical Kukri. It’s available from the outset of the mission along with a handgun, and you can draw the Kukri by long-pressing the default V button (the quick melee action is still available via quick-pressing the V button when the Kukri is not in use). The big perk of the Kukri is the ability to parry melee attacks by clicking the right mouse button, thus considerably reducing the received melee damage. 

6. There is no final boss, and your mission is to extract in time before the Threat and Contamination Levels are so high, you are doomed to die. Extraction can be requested via the same Mule Communicators.


[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]

Health regeneration speed now depends on your movement speed. The regeneration speed is at maximum when you are not moving, decreases when you are walking, and decreases even further when you are running. A special icon to reflect the current regeneration speed was added under the player health bar. 


[h3]MISCELLANEOUS[/h3]

[list]
[*] We've implemented the first iteration of the Text Chat. It is available for communication within the team in session in all game modes (default "Y"). Coordinating your actions is now easier.
[*] Fullscreen and the 60 FPS cap are now the default settings. You can change them in Options to your liking.
[*] Active weapon modification perk is now displayed on the Esc-button menu.
[*] A special animation when a new weapon is unlocked.
[*] A QR code with a link to Shatterline Discord Community was added to the Expedition loading screen while at the beginning of an Expedition a prompt to press the default T to use the in-game voice chat is shown.
[*] Weapon inspection for the SAG-8 Reaper sniper rifle. 
[/list]


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Crash fixes, various character and weapon visual fixes, and localization fixes.
[*] Fixed bug where the player could get stuck in the crates at the Strafer Base in the Intro Mission.
[*] Fixed bug where the player could get outside of the Queen boss fight arena in the Red Lake episode.
[*] Fixed bug with the G9 Kungel pistol inspection where the inspection sounds could continue after the player interrupted the inspection by starting moving.
[*] Fixed bug when a Glasshead that was blinded by a flash grenade could start sliding toward the player.
[*] Fixed bug in Expedition with invisible walls at the Strafer Base and at the Waterfall.
[*] Fixed bug in Expedition where the Research Station door wouldn't close after the encounter activation.
[*] Fixed bug in Expedition where the Spiked Orb could spawn too high in the sky if there were high cliffs around the encounter site.
[*] Fixed bug in the Red Lake episode where the player could get stuck in the rocks near the Third Transmitter.
[*] Fixed bug with a blurry RN Stilcomb sight for the Λ-9 Legatus assault rifle when the player was aiming down sights.
[*] Fixed bug in the Escort map where the player could get to a non-playable area using Ram's ultimate ability.
[*] Fixed bug in the Escort map where the shots didn't get through the wrought iron fence of the second-floor terrace.
[*] Fixed bug where movable objects didn't destroy crystalline.
[*] Fixed bug where the operative's ability video in the Operatives menu could get stuck if the mouse was moved to a non-equipped ability. 
[*] Fixed bug in the Shooting Range where the distance marker fell underground after a dummy target was killed.
[*] Fixed bug in the Armory where all weapon modifications perk descriptions were mentioned twice.
[*] Fixed bug where the %sl_presence% text was shown in the players' Steam badge to their Steam friends instead of a PvP match status in the game.
[*] Fixed bug where the CLAW FP grip for the Λ-1 Centurion submachine gun increased the weapon's stability instead of accuracy.
[*] Fixed bug where the Momentum Booster attachment added a bullet after every kill instead of every two kills.
[*] Fixed bug where event tasks were shown when there was no active event.
[*] Fixed bug where the Dragonfly Stradivari and Dragonfly Constellation sniper rifle modifications with the AM4 MAG magazine had 22 bullets instead of 21.
[*] Fixed bug where activating Ram's ultimate ability and interacting with an object a split second after that made Ram lose his weapons, abilities, and sprint function.
[/list]

notes.title: Update R72: Season Charlie
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends! 

Season Charlie has finally arrived!

We have a lot of good stuff for you in today's March Update (R72). 

[previewyoutube=tf0TSlcUTPk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]SEASON CHARLIE[/h3]

Season Charlie has brought, among other things:
• New tasks and cool rewards, including:
• • Two new weapons: the [i]Λ-7 Ghost[/i] assault rifle and the [i]G9 Kungen[/i] pistol.
• • Spiffy outfits:  Orbit's Deimos Suit and Kite's Anubis Suit.
• Seven new weapon modifications to craft:
• • [i]M2 Tactical Bloodstream[/i] shotgun (2 extra ammo in the tube)
• • [i]Black Falcon Chornobyl[/i] shotgun (effective range is increased by 10%)
• • [i]Dragonfly Stradivari[/i] sniper rifle (weapon stability is increased by 10%)
• • [i]Legatus Mural[/i] assault rifle (effective range is increased by 5%)
• • [i]M5 Angry Cloud [/i]submachine gun (weapon selection speed is increased by 13%)
• • [i]Firespray Gator[/i] submachine gun (weapon stability is increased by 10% and accuracy - by 5%)
• • [i]Svarog Constellation[/i] revolver (weapon stability is increased by 10%).
• New PvE episode: Twin Stilts.
• New Escort map: Barracuda
• New 3v3 PvP mode with three maps: Subway, Ruins, and City Hall.

[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]

[u]PvE combat changes[/u]:

 • We have been preparing some interesting changes for PvE combat mechanics to create a more engaging combat. You will see a part of these changes in the current update while the rest will follow suit later on.
• Melee AIs ([i]Glassheads[/i]). To tell you the truth, we were not particularly happy with how they performed as they were way too fast and didn't contribute enough to the gameplay. Thus, we increased their health, decreased their damage, lowered the maximum speed, and extended the stagger feature.
•[i] AIs' stagger[/i]. You may have noticed that when AIs received enough damage, they halted, breaking their attack for a moment. This stagger depended on the amount of received damage, therefore higher-damage weapons were much better at it than other weapons. We changed this by introducing a new stagger parameter into weapons and abilities (the only ability that has it right now is Stryx's Crystalline Grenade), thus the AIs' stagger depends on this parameter and not on the sustained damage as it was before. This change should provide more depth and meaning to the stagger mechanic. Furthermore, some enemies will be highlighted as being in the Stagger State, informing the player that the enemy is weakened and will incur additional damage.
• The above-mentioned stagger mechanic will also apply to the player, albeit in PvE only. When players receive a certain amount of melee or area-of-effect damage, their maximum speed will get lower and they will receive increased melee damage for a brief period of time. Don't get swarmed!

[u]Other AI changes[/u]:

• The Strafers now prioritize covers when possible.
• The in-flight time of Minotaur's rockets (the time between their launch and impact) has increased.
• Mongoose's frag grenade tweak: The frag grenade had an increased radius of explosion in PvE missions (episodes and Blitz missions). Now, this increased explosion radius has been extended to Expedition.

[u]Shotguns rebalance[/u]:

(ATTENTION: [i]The shotgun changes are not final, thus prone to fine-tuning and rework[/i])

The shotguns got changed differently for PvE and for PvP.
• In PvP, all primary shotguns (the [i]Lupara Compatta[/i] is considered a secondary shotgun, so it is not part of this change) got their damage at midrange decreased by around 35% on average. The [i]Lupara Compatta[/i]'s damage at midrange decreased by around 30%.
• In PvE, all primary shotguns got a huge increase in damage at midrange.
• In the Shooting Range, the shotguns work as if in PvP.


[h3]MISCELLANEOUS[/h3]

• The Task Widget now shows the remaining time until new daily tasks arrive.
• The Game Store tiles received a new visual.
• The weapon chart shows the new stagger parameter discussed in the Balance Changes above.
• In Expedition, the in-game ESC menu has got a new button called "I'm stuck." As you can easily guess, you may now report a spot on the map where you got stuck and couldn't get out. It will help us fix such annoying issues quicker.
• Players in a party get twice as much time to reconnect to the match in comparison with a solo player.
• Voice chat is muted if the game is minimized.
• [i]Luppara Compatta[/i], [i]Black Falcon II[/i], [i]M2 Tactical SAS[/i], and [i]Λ-9 Legatus[/i] have got their long-deserved inspection animation.
• Ram's Gravity Strike ability got the enemy-foe color differentiation: blue for the friendly and red for the enemy.
• From now on, Season Pass boosters increase your season experience points received from playing matches but don't apply to season experience points obtained from completing game tasks.


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

• Crash fixes.
• Fixed issue with a missing magazine reload animation for the [i]SAG-8 Reaper[/i] sniper rifle.
• Fixed issue where spotting marks remained on the HUD during a play-of-the-game replay.
• Fixed issue with the [i]Momentum Booster[/i] attachment for the [i]TWD X-treme [/i]sniper rifle when it allowed shooting two bullets without reloading.
• Fixed issue with incorrect animation of the [i]Lupara Siciliana [/i]secondary shotgun modification when the player stood idly.
• Fixed issue with missing red fog indicating hazard areas in the Sunken Lab blitz mission.
• Fixed issue with the Mitigator grip attachment causing a loud reload sound for the [i]Λ-9 Legatus [/i]assault rife.
• Fixed issue with the [i]Drachen Racer[/i] submachine gun modification equipped with either the [i]Gunstream Z-54[/i] or [i]Tridot GO[/i] rds where the screen outside the zoomed-in area went black for a second when you were hit by a sniper.
• Fixed issue where the throwing of the [i]Firewave Grenade[/i] took longer than the throwing of the [i]Wall Grenade[/i] by Strix.
• Fixed issue where a reload animation of the [i]Zenith [/i]assault rifle could be missing when reloading the gun for the second time.
• Fixed issue where Strafers could get stuck in some covers.
• Fixed issue where a player could get into a non-playable area on the Death Lab and Nisida PvP maps by using Orbit's dash ability.
• Fixed issue where all HUD markers failed to display in 4K resolution if AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution was enabled.
• Fixed issue where the Double Trouble task was not displayed as a PvP-only task.
• Fixed issue where the use of the [i]Selenium Ammo[/i] attachment on the [i]G07 Springer[/i] hid its [i]Carbon Handle[/i] grip in the Armory.
• Fixed issue with the missing sounds of lava boulders in Expedition.
• Fixed issue where players were always resurrected with a primary weapon, even if they died with a secondary.
• Fixed issue on the Escape PvP map where a player could fall under terrain at several spots.
• Fixed issue where the game client could get stuck when a player quickly switched between weapons in the Armory.
• Fixed issue with an incorrect description of the [i]Black Falcon II[/i]'s [i]Titanium Pellets[/i] attachment.
• Fixed issue where Ram could perform a gravity strike or throw an axe while using his ultimate ability.
• Fixed issue where the kill counter showed an incorrect number of kills in the Armory if it was used on various weapons.
• Fixed issue with overlapping music if you played consecutive matches or left the game session and joined another one.

notes.title: Update R71
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

The February update has arrived!

[h3]Key changes[/h3]

• The Bodybuilder Season in Expedition has run to its end. Vanilla Expedition is back in the game.
• Improved animation of the Bomb Dogs' attack, Chaser's flight and attack, and Strafers' movement.
• New weapon inspection for the XM-40 Conciliator assault rifle, the U44 Culverina revolver, the Λ-1 Centurion submachine gun and Centurion Perforator, its legendary modification.
• A new tooltip for tasks progress on the Session Details Screen so that you may see detailed info on every task.
• The number of Blueprints you have is now depicted next to other currencies at the top right corner of the lobby screen.
• In case of a connection issue, you will see a new icon indicating such an issue. The icon is yellow when the connection is bad, and red when it's very bad.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Pr9Jh6gj/lost-connection-yellow.png[/img] [img]https://i.postimg.cc/NjXM06tr/lost-connection-red.png[/img]

• The party (squad) leader has now two more actions: kick a player from the squad and assign another player as a squad leader.
• Player statistics, one of the most requested features, has finally arrived!
• • The statistics screen is accessible by clicking on the player's badge and choosing the "Show Profile Info" button.
• • Player statistics are split into Overall Statistics and Season Pass Statistics.
• • The Operative shown on the Statistics Screen is your most played operative together with your most played weapon.
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/HxRRjydV/stat-e.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/HxRRjydV/stat-e.png[/img][/url]

• A new Preview Window for Season Pass rewards and Store items, where you can view the item and its description in detail.
• The Kill Cam was improved. Since many kills/deaths occur when both parties are moving, the Kill Cam could show the killer being behind a cover a moment after the kill. Of course, at the precise moment of the kill, the killer had a direct line of sight, but the way the camera showed it could be quite disconcerting. With this improvement, the number of such erroneous cases is minimized.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

• Several crash fixes.
• Fixed issue where a single shot from assault rifles sounded as two shots in quick succession.
• Fixed issue when a player’s name in the voice chat could stay on screen until the end of the game session.
• Fixed issue where several Death Lab PvP map features did not appear on the mini-map.
• Fixed issue where the kill sound failed to play when the kill was performed with a headshot.
• Fixed issue where zoom-in and zoom-out sounds were missing for the G5 Earl pistol and U22 Svarog revolver.
• Fixes for minor visual issues on the Invasion mode map, Hecatomb, Redlake, and Border Control episodes, the Cybertrail blitz mission, and the Island PvP map.
• Fixed issue where the list of tasks could not be scrolled on the session-end screen.
• Fixed issue where some areas on the Highpick map and Escort mode Escape map were overexposed at low graphics quality.
• Fixed issue where the GS TAL-I11 under-barrel attachment’s 15%-increase in hip fire accuracy wasn’t displayed correctly on the weapon chart.
• Fixed issues with several places on the Escort March map that could be used to reach high ground, but were not designed to provide such an opportunity.
• Fixed issue with reloading animation for the M2 Tactical SAS shotgun.
• Fixed issue where Ram’s ultimate ability could recharge if he got killed mid-flight.
• Fixed issue where Orbit ultimate’s sound looped if he died right after his ultimate’s activation.
• Fixed issue where the player report button wouldn’t work on the session-end details screen.
• Fixed issue where the icon of a craft version of the U44 Culverina revolver (unavailable for crafting) was present on the Weapons Screen.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the Laser Supply Encounter could fail to complete.
• Fixed issue where completing an Invasion match didn’t count into the Mingler task (Play event modes).
• Fixed issue where a player could pass through a wall on the Barricade mode map and fall under the terrain.
• Fixed issue in the Border Control episode where an ammo crate could fail to work after the player’s respawn during the final boss fight.
• Localization fixes.

notes.title: Update R70
notes.content:
Hi there, Shatterliners! 

The January update (Release 70) is here! Here is what it's brought.

[previewyoutube=UOwdhqTg4as;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]R70 Release Notes[/h2]

The holiday event is over, and so is the hunt for fireworks stashes.

[h3]Upscaling Tech[/h3]

• AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution is available in the game options.

[h3]Movement[/h3]

• We tweaked the slide a bit. You can now slide infinitely down a slope and take a crouching position after canceling the slide. 

[h3]Expedition[/h3]

• Now all weapons retain their attachments in Expedition. Before this change, only weapons equipped on the operative before launching the Expedition were present in an Expedition match.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

• Kite's remote mine improvements:
• • it now ignores enemy drones;
• • the mine's flare has become more pronounced;
• • it beeps in the spectator mode and during the best moment replay;
• • the mine's ability button on HUD now blinks with a blue tint when an enemy is in close proximity to it (in sync with the audio beep);

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Nj15v3YS/rd01-use-ui-beeper-low.gif[/img]

• • the ability button blinks in a more pronounced manner with a yellow tint when an enemy is within the range that guarantees a kill.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hFYpVRq/rd01-use-ui-beeper-high.gif[/img]

[h3]UI/HUD[/h3]

• Fine-tuned design of the Operative's Equipment Screen.
• The Operatives Customization Screen was improved: now you can sweep through different operatives' Cosmetics, Equipment, and Progression without the need to leave the Customization Screen.
• Game tasks are now sorted in the following order: progressed, not progressed, and completed.
• The friends who are online are shown at the top of the friend list.
• For platform compatibility, long player names are truncated to 24 symbols.
• To avoid confusion, the "Customize" button in the Armory will be called "Preview" for weapons yet to be unlocked.
• Redesigned notification for encounter completion in Expedition.
• In the Coop and PvEvP (Invasion) modes, dead AI enemies no longer appear on the radar.
• To improve targeting, all weapon scopes reticle and RDS color was changed to green. Since enemy outlines are red and many AIs have red color on them, it was quite difficult to discern the red dot and reticles against red enemies. 

[h3]Game Options[/h3]

• The interface language can now be changed in the "Interface language" option under General Options.

[h3]Animation[/h3]

• Improved third-person character animations in the idle pose, when aiming down sights, on-spot and in-sprint rotation, and transition from sprint and run to a stop.
• Improved Gardener AI animation.
• Weapon inspection animation for the [i]R21 Brute[/i] shotgun, the [i]TWD X-Treme[/i] sniper rifle and [i]X-Treme Lone Wolf [/i]modification, the[i] Dragonfly[/i] sniper rifle, the [i]Λ-3 Pilum[/i] assault rifle and [i]Pilum Ivory[/i] modification, the [i]G7 Springer pistol[/i]. Updated animation of [i]Λ-3 Pilum[/i] and [i]Pilum Ivory[/i]. 

[h3]Audio[/h3]

• Improved ambient sounds and cutscene audio in the Border Control Coop mission.

[h3]KEY BUG FIXES[/h3]

• Fixed issue in Invasion where Ram could one-shot kill the Stilt boss with his ultimate.
• Fixed issue in Invasion where Orbit could get on top of the first core gate using his leap ability.
• Fixed issue in Invasion where the Meteor Strike ability could be spammed infinitely if the Invader had been killed when activating the strategic ability.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where secondary encounter supply crates could fail to open sometimes.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the boss fight wouldn't start if the players triggered a secondary encounter (but didn't complete it) before triggering the boss fight, returned and finalized the secondary encounter.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get stuck in crystalline near the bunker.
• Fixed issue where Orbit's leap speed was faster if performed diagonally in comparison with a forward leap.
• Fixed issue where Orbit could kill an enemy with a headshot when using his ultimate ability.
• Fixed issue where the sounds of Ram's ultimate and gravity strike disappeared if Ram wore any outfit.
• Fixed issue in Terminal and Nisida PvP maps where a player could get to non-playable areas by using the operative's abilities.
• Fixed issue where the death from kick didn't count as a kill for the kicker if the enemy was kicked outside of the map.
• Another fix for the issue where a cart could move on its own in the Escort mode.
• Multiple HUD and UI bug fixes.
• Fixed localization issues with mixed-up attachment descriptions for the [i]G7 Springer[/i] pistol, incorrect buff duration description of the [i]U22 Svarog[/i]'s Sheriff Holsterattachment, incorrect localization of the Kite's remote mine detonator, and the Escort Mode Escape map name on the session loading screen.
• Weapon animation fixes for the[i] Z-940 Drachen[/i], [i]Cinetech M5[/i], [i]Black Falcon[/i], [i]XM-27 Pacifier[/i], and [i]SAG-8 Reaper[/i].
• Crash fixes.
