• Fixed localization issues with mixed-up attachment descriptions for the G7 Springer pistol, incorrect buff duration description of the U22 Svarog's Sheriff Holsterattachment, incorrect localization of the Kite's remote mine detonator, and the Escort Mode Escape map name on the session loading screen.
• Weapon animation fixes for the Z-940 Drachen, Cinetech M5, Black Falcon, XM-27 Pacifier, and SAG-8 Reaper.
• Crash fixes.

notes.title: Update R69: Winter Holidays
notes.content:
Greetings, Shatterliners! 

The December holiday update (Release 69) has arrived! Dive into the release notes below to see what's new.

[previewyoutube=Q6hlKqxkgOE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]R69 Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]ATTENTION:[/h3] Due to the change in the location of the player profile data folder, all player's settings will be reset (game settings, ticked PvP modes, new and seen item differentiation; the game's first launch cinematic will be played again; the game will also start with the Intro Mission). Our apologies for the inconvenience.

[h3]Holidays Special[/h3]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7YP4x1Jz/GIf-face.gif[/img]

• Special Chrismas items are waiting for you (some - as game task rewards, others - as offers in the Game Store):
• • Chrismas bundle with "Silent Night" weapon skins in the Store: XM27 Pacifier, U44 Culverina, R60 Gevaudan, Cinetech M5, and SAG-8 Reaper.
• • "Silent Night" weapon skins as task rewards: Λ-3 Pilum, G5 Earl, Berlington TAC, Λ-1 Centurion, and Presarm VX-7.
• • Other weapon cosmetics: Muffin Man weapon trinket (Store item), "Happy Holidays" rail cover, three Xmas weapon stickers (Rasta Claus, Ho-ho-ho, and Crystletoe).
• • Operatives cosmetics: Santa's beard, glasses, and hat for all operatives (Store items).
• Relaxing holiday music in the Lobby. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zGxKtY4Q/GIf-WP.gif[/img]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

[i][b]Weapon balance changes[/b][/i]:
• [i]Berlington TAC [/i]and [i]R60 Gevaudan[/i] shotguns: slightly decreased damage.
• [i]Firespray[/i] submachine gun: the precision damage and precision effective distance were slightly decreased.
• [i]CLAW FP[/i] vertical grip for the [i]Firespray[/i] submachine gun: the 7% stability buff was replaced with the 10% accuracy buff.
• [i]Presarm VX7[/i], [i]SAG8 Reaper[/i], and [i]TWD X-treme[/i] sniper rifles: decreased accuracy .  

[i][b]Escort Mode tweaks:[/b][/i]
• The cart now moves at different speeds depending on the number of players pushing it. If there is only one player pushing the cart, the speed is 1.5 meters per second; two - 2 m/s; three or more - 2.5 m/s.
• The cart will move backward at a speed of 0.25 m/s when controlled by the enemy.
• The cart circle is colored yellow when it is contested, and red when it is controlled by the enemy and is moving backward. [u]KNOWN ISSUE[/u]: On the March map, the colors are reversed: the cart zone is red when controlled by friendlies and blue when controlled by the enemy. 
• The radar spotting distance is increased by 40%. 

[i][b]Ram's Explosive Axe improvements[/b][/i]:
• Enemy Axe can now be destroyed by shooting at it.
• Improved audio effects.

[h3]Maps & Modes[/h3]

• A new Coop episode: [i][b]Border Control[/b][/i].
• [i][b]Invasion [/b][/i]PvEvP event (January 2-9, 2023) where three Shellguard operatives fight against one Chosen player and environment. Not an easy task for either side.
• • Please note that since this mode is still in development, its performance is 10-15% lower in comparison with other modes.
• Expedition Mode update: the new Strafer Vault encounter and three new secondary encounters.
• [i][b]Extreme Expedition[/b][/i] event (January 12-16, 2023):
• • AI hit points are increased 2.5 times.
• • Incoming damage is increased by 20%, weak point damage is increased by 2.5 times.
• • Additional weapon type damage multipliers: submachine guns: +10%, sniper rifles: -20%; shotguns: +80%.
• • Contamination Overdose: two contamination modifiers are present from the start.
• •  Infinite Contamination: after 5 levels of contamination, the players get -20 HP to health cap for each consecutive contamination level.
• [i][b]Juggernaut Escort[/b][/i] event (January 9-13, 2023)
• • Escort Mode with twice the hit points.
• Coop missions are now grouped into two categories for your convenience: Episodes and Blitz missions.
• Updated Escort map for Escort Mode.
• • Tweaked spawn points.
• • New objects were introduced, and some old objects positions were changed.
• • Tweaked kill zones and the cart path.
• • The defender's recon class climb on the bridge was removed.
• • Two exploit positions in the final stage area were closed.
• • A side path at the U-shaped road turn on the cliff was added.
• • The covers at the cave bunker exit were extended. 
• • A zip line across the ravine was added. 
• • The sniper position after the bridge was removed.
• Updated March map for Escort Mode.
• • Tweaked spawn points.
• • New objects were introduced, and some old objects positions were changed.
• • Tweaked kill zones and cart path.
• • We removed the sniper position and Recon class climbs at the final gate, while the final gate construction was tweaked.

[h3]Animation[/h3]

• Updated slide animation in third-person view.
• Updated operatives animation on the Prebattle Screen.
• New animation for the Lupara Compatta pistol.

[h3]UI[/h3]

• The Crafting Screen got some minor improvements and was moved to the Armory submenu.

[h3]Session Reconnect[/h3]

• If players get disconnected from the game session due to a network error (Error 09-XX), they will be offered to reconnect back to the session after they return to the game lobby.

[h3]Content Creators Support[/h3]

• In cooperation with Nexus.gg, we added the functionality to support your favorite content creator. With a special creator’s code, part of every purchase you make goes to the creator you choose.
• Content creators are now able to distribute unique content among their followers by means of a redemption code in the game.

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]

• New instant awards:
• • Airborne: for two while-in-mid-air kills in PvP or five such kills in PvE.
• • Luddite: for killing three enemy drones in PvP.
• • Ping & spotter: for five pings in a match.
• • Pimple remover: for destroying three cart pimples in Escort Mode.
• • Oh, crap!: for a self-kill.
• • Wall-breaker: for destroying three crystalline walls in PvP.
• • Zipliner: well, for using a zip line obviously. 
• Improved geometry of the Alpha-Sight and the FS Assassin pistol extenders (weapon attachments).
• Audio improvements for the Queen AI, the Mine Field in Expedition, Hecatomb Coop Episode, and destructible doors on different maps.
• Updated Japanese font.

[h3]Key bug fixes[/h3]

• Fixed issue where the Strafer AI bodies could have unnatural arm positions if killed by an explosion.
• Fixed issue with a clunky weapon selection animation if done when sprinting.
• Fixed issue where the resurrector's camera could rotate after switching from third-person to first-person view after revival.
• Fixed issue where the new item icon didn't show on the weapon customization button or the customization type button for the yet-locked weapon (for instance, when a new skin was received from a box).
• Fixed issue where the text for some tasks could be cut-off.
• Fixed issue where the weapon attachments section for an unlocked weapon lacked any information that the player should acquire the weapon first to proceed to attachments.
• Fixed audio issues in the Expedition initial cutscene, Hecatomb episode radio exchanges and boss fight, and Sunken Lab episode narration.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the Lucky Bulletperk stopped working after the player received a new weapon from the supply box.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the boss fight wouldn't end if the Healing Anomaly modifier was active.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where sample capsules could fail to be picked up at the Sample Extraction encounter.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the Koshchei and the Fusion Reactor encounters could fail to start if a player proceeded to them without finishing active secondary encounters, but finally completing the secondaries afterward.
• Fixed issue in the Hecatomb episode with a big performance drop at the Kioni stasis chamber cinematic.
• Fixed issue where the Minotaur AI could get the damage from a grenade explosion.
• Fixed issue on the Old Town map where a player could shoot through a narrow gap under the window on top of the clocktower.
• Fixed issue on the Old Town map where a player could get on the roof of one of the buildings by jumping on a crystalline wall.
• Fixed issue in the Conquest mode where the objective icon could point in the wrong direction during the first couple of seconds.
• Fixed issue with the Impala Sea Beast sniper rifle modification where the rail patch could not be easily discerned on the weapon.
• Fixed issue where an operative model could be in the wrong position on the Play screen if the player left the match with the Esc menu.
• Fixed issue with the Large buckshot ammo weapon attachment where the attachment reduced the weapon range.
• Fixed issue where the TWD X-Treme and the SAG-8 Reaper sniper rifles didn't affect the sprint speed which in effect should be 10% lower.
• Fixed issues with Orbit's ultimate where it could be discharged at respawn even if the injection hadn't been completed or the ultimate's charge level could rapidly decrease after activation.
• Fixed issue where Strix's Fire Wave grenade kill didn't count as an ability kill.
• Fixed issue where the G7 Springer's Selenium Ammo attachment hid the Brightline XC-1's laser beam when the two attachments were equipped at the same time.
• Fixed issue with the Craft Machine where the machine's opening animation failed to play when crafting a weapon.
• Fixed issue where the Earl Samurai pistol modification was not displayed in the Amory while the modification could be crafted.
• Fixed issue where an ultimate weapon was charging too fast from abilities use.
• Fixed issue where a player could see through the smoke at low graphics settings.
• Crash fixes.
• Minor UI bug fixes.
• Localization fixes.

[previewyoutube=Wqd6Eq4JQWg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 68.2
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 68.1  (December 2)[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
• There was an issue with the December 1 update where the weekly tasks progress of the majority of players migrated from Season Alpha to Season Bravo. So we had to reset the progress of all weekly tasks in Season Bravo.
•  Boosters. 
• • The booster for 100% was deactivated as it should have been active only during Season Alpha.
• • Due to a bug, the new season boosters turned out to be too high. This led to a ludicrously increased season pass progression speed. We decreased the booster values as a fix.
•  Fixed issue in the Game Store where items purchased in Season Alpha were still displayed in Season Bravo. 
•  Fixed issue with cosmetics boxes where the player received a small number of coins instead of a purchased weapon or operative skin.

[h3]Tweaks in Expedition: Bodybuilder season [/h3]
• We increased the number of health points: instead of 100 HP at the start of the mission and 150 as the maximum, you will begin with 120 and can increase it to 170! This means that:
• • Your maximum HP is +20 in comparison with the previous season.
• • The number of deaths from one-shot enemy kills will decrease dramatically.
• • Bodybuilder perks should feel less essential resulting in more viable builds
• We significantly increased the chance of golden (3-slot) lost supply bins. More perk choices as a result. 2)

notes.title: Update R68: Season Bravo
notes.content:
Hey there, Shatterliners!

A new game season has arrived in our December update. 

[url=https://ibb.co/bmrjyZD][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Cxwv3zrQ/Season-Bravo.png[/img][/url]

Here's the list of key changes and fixes in the December update.

[h2]New Season Bravo[/h2]

• Lots of cool stuff in the season rewards.
• New weapon modifications in the Craft Machine (Season Alpha modifications also stay)
• • Centurion Perforator
• • Tornado Diesel
• • Earl Samurai
• • X-Treme Lone Wolf
• • Pacifier Crusader
• • Conciliator Kumo
• • Springer Deep Space
• • Impala Starfall
• • Zenith Deep Space
• • Svarog Art Deco
• • M2 Tactical Pixel
• • Firespray Hot Rod 
• • Pilum Kawaii
• • Black Falcon Deep Space
• • Dragonfly Constellation
• • Culverina Shatterline
• • Brute Starfall
• • Gevaudan Danger

[h2]New Expedition season: Bodybuilder[/h2]

• You start with 2/3 of your max health, but your maximum health cap can be increased by defeating enemies with different weapon types (depending on the perks you have). The perk for sidearms is provided by default. Be aware: the increased health cap will reset when you die.
• A whole new set of 14 perks related to the Bodybuilder seasonal mechanic is added to the perk pool (with some of the old perks phased out).
• New primary encounter: Koschei.
• 5 new supply drop encounters.

[h2] Сoop Missions and PvP Modes[/h2]

• Cyber Trail coop episode
• Contaminated Hecatomb episode (event)
• Domination PvP mode (to launch on December 5)
• Instead of PvE missions rotated every day, they are now in a random playlist.
• Demolition Mode was removed from the Versus playlist.

[h2]Performance[/h2]

• We increased performance on the low graphical settings at the cost of some graphics quality compromises.
• We also updated the graphics settings autodetection feature so now it should work better. Additionally, the default Display Mode is changed from Windowed Borderless to Fullscreen.
• The downside of these improvements is that your current graphics settings as well as your chosen server regions will reset. Our apologies for this inconvenience.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

• We changed the mechanics of Malva's Medkit. It now instantly restores anything lower than 50 hit points to the said 50, and heals another 100 over the next 2 seconds.
• Several Ram's abilities were rebalanced or fine-tuned:
• • The Throwing Axe and the Explosive Axe. Ram's Throwing Axe cannot be picked up if damage has been dealt to the enemy; it self-destroys at enemy death; and it doesn't detach from enemies after a timeout anymore. The Explosive Axe now deals small damage on hitting enemies (50 hit points in PvP and 500 in PvE) and detonates after 0.7 sec after impact (previously it was detonating instantly on hit). If it fails to hit an enemy, it remains active for 10 sec. During this time, Ram can pick it back up or an enemy may pass by at a close distance (0.4-meter radius) triggering the axe's detonation within 0.7 seconds. After 10 seconds, the axe will self-detonate, producing a beeping sound 3 seconds before self-detonation.
• • Ram's Gravity Strike charge affects only effective range now (previously it affected also impulse and damage). As a result, it is easier to use the Gravity Strike at a low charge, but the range is limited.
• • And finally, during his ultimate ability flight, Ram can now strafe to the sides using the A and D keys
• The number of retries in PvE missions was increased to 3 per checkpoint.

[h2]Animation & VFX[/h2]
 
• Updated Brisa's presentation on the Play screen.
•  Updated animation for character vaulting over obstacles in third-person view and sprint animation in first-person view .
• New weapon inspection animation for Svarog Cossack legendary pistol modification, Cinetech M5 and Firespray submachine guns, VX-7 Santa Muerte legendary sniper rifle modification, and R60 Gevaudan shotgun.
 • New visual effects for Ram's Gravity Strike ability charge.
 • Improved jump and ranged attack animation of the Behemoth boss AI.

[h2]Game Controller[/h2]

• The Aim Assist setting was added to the Controller options. You can choose between Off, Weak, Normal, and Strong settings.

[h2]User Interface[/h2]

• Task Widget visual improvements: the task description was moved lower while additional rewards were moved higher; the pop-up task details are larger to include more information.
• The Task widget is accessible in Escape Menu on the Pre-Battle Screen.
• Nameplates are now featured on the Kill and MVP screens.

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]

• Matchmaking was improved to prioritize players' ping values when adding people to a game room. This should improve hit registration.

[h2]Game Store[/h2]

• You can purchase a Premium Season Pass bundled with several completed levels.
• Game Store updates that will rotate throughout the season.

[h2]Key bug fixes[/h2]

• Fixed crashes at the session end and the Play of the Game replay.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the Phantom Core encounter couldn't be completed if a player disconnected from the game when in the portal.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where Kinetic Armor and Blast Armor perk names were mixed up.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get stuck in a crystalline formation near the village.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where a player could get an additional weapon after joining an ongoing mission.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the Chaser marked with the Strife perk continued attacking the players.
• Fixed issue in Expedition with no contamination icons on HUD after the player's reconnection to the match. 
• Fixed issue in Expedition where the supply box wouldn't open under certain conditions if a player left the session and another joined afterward.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where a lost supply box and a cat figurine could spawn on the same spot thus making both unusable to players.
• Fixed issue in Expedition where players could see more than 5 contamination levels on the Esc menu if they changed their operative after four contamination levels.
• Fixed issue in Expedition with a missing physics for some tank containers.
• Fixed issue where Kite's remote mine failed to detonate if the animation of pressing the detonation button was interrupted.
• Fixed issue where players could not be invited to the squad if they declined a previous invitation. The game reboot was needed.
• Fixed issue where player badges could be placed all around the match scoreboard.
• Fixed issue in the Redlake episode where players could get outside of the playable area.
• Fixed issue in the Redlake episode where the AIs could follow the players into the canyon and get stuck.
• Fixed issue in the Hecatomb episode where a player could get stuck on the crates in one of the laboratories. 
• Fixed issue in the Escort map where the audio announcement was repeated every 10 seconds.
• Fixed issue in the Escort map where a player could respawn under the map.
• Fixed issue in the Escort map where a player could get into non-playable areas.
• Fixed issue in the Escort Mode where the convoyed cart could move on its own, without the attacker team nearby.
• Fixed issue where a destructible door and its visual indicator remained in place after the player was killed and respawned.
• Fixed issue where sniper rifles could start shooting inaccurately after weapon changes.
• Fixed issue where Orbit's ultimate continued working after respawn.
• Fixed issue where the weapon draw animation played twice after the player jumped off a zip line.
• Fixed issue in the Escort and Terminal maps where object outlines on the minimap differed from the actual objects on the map.
• Fixed issue where the scope reticle moved with a delay when the player was ADS and changed aiming direction.
• Fixed issue with absent music on the Hecatomb episode result screen.
• Fixed issue with absent visual effects of the Behemoth boss melee attack.
• Fixed issue with incorrect icons for Ram's Hyperdash and Gravity Strike abilities on the Operatives screen.
• Fixed issue on the Old Town map where the character jittered while standing close to the stairs rail on the bridge.
• Fixed issue where the Lupara Compatta pistol was equipped with the muzzle break attachment, but this attachment was not shown on the pistol during the game.
• Fixed issue with Malva's Pincher Drone that left its physics on the level after being destroyed so that the spot could not be shot through.
• Fixed issue where there was a visual twitch in the Mongoose Headbutt ability when used together with the left or right movement.
• Fixed issue where Brisa's glass mine could damage friendlies if they were trapped there with an enemy.
• Fixed issue with missing visual and audio feedback when trying to use a non-ready operative's ability.
• Fixed issue on the Island map where a player could get on top of one of the villas and have an advantage over other players. We also fixed the issue when a player could pass through the walls of the central building in several hard-to-reach spots.
• Fixed issue on the Island map where players might fail to use the zip line if they were standing close to the fence.
• Fixed issue where Malva's neck intersected her outfit.
• Fixed issue with several missing visual effects on the Brittle Splinter AI.• Fixed issue in the Game Store where the purchased box failed to open.
• Fixed issue where character bodies could be twisted on the match Result Screen.
• Fixed issue where enemy outlines could be seen through the smoke if particle quality was set to low in the graphics options.
• Localization fixes.

• A whole new set of 14 perks related to the Bodybuilder seasonal mechanic is added to the perk pool (with some of the old perks phased out).
• New primary encounter: Koschei.
• 5 new supply drop encounters.
• Cyber Trail coop episode
• Contaminated Hecatomb episode (event)
• Domination PvP mode (to launch on December 5)
• Instead of PvE missions rotated every day, they are now in a random playlist.
• We increased performance on the low graphical settings at the cost of some graphics quality compromises.
• We also updated the graphics settings autodetection feature so now it should work better. Additionally, the default Display Mode is changed from Windowed Borderless to Fullscreen.
• The Aim Assist setting was added to the Controller options. You can choose between Off, Weak, Normal, and Strong settings.
• Task Widget visual improvements: the task description was moved lower while additional rewards were moved higher; the pop-up task details are larger to include more information.
• The Task widget is accessible in Escape Menu on the Pre-Battle Screen.
• Nameplates are now featured on the Kill and MVP screens.
• Matchmaking was improved to prioritize players' ping values when adding people to a game room. This should improve hit registration.
• You can purchase a Premium Season Pass bundled with several completed levels.
• Game Store updates that will rotate throughout the season.

tags.balance_change: • We changed the mechanics of Malva's Medkit. It now instantly restores anything lower than 50 hit points to the said 50, and heals another 100 over the next 2 seconds.
• Several Ram's abilities were rebalanced or fine-tuned:

• • The Throwing Axe and the Explosive Axe. Ram's Throwing Axe cannot be picked up if damage has been dealt to the enemy; it self-destroys at enemy death; and it doesn't detach from enemies after a timeout anymore. The Explosive Axe now deals small damage on hitting enemies (50 hit points in PvP and 500 in PvE) and detonates after 0.7 sec after impact (previously it was detonating instantly on hit). If it fails to hit an enemy, it remains active for 10 sec. During this time, Ram can pick it back up or an enemy may pass by at a close distance (0.4-meter radius) triggering the axe's detonation within 0.7 seconds. After 10 seconds, the axe will self-detonate, producing a beeping sound 3 seconds before self-detonation.

• • Ram's Gravity Strike charge affects only effective range now (previously it affected also impulse and damage). As a result, it is easier to use the Gravity Strike at a low charge, but the range is limited.
• • And finally, during his ultimate ability flight, Ram can now strafe to the sides using the A and D keys
• The number of retries in PvE missions was increased to 3 per checkpoint.

notes.title: Update R67
notes.content:
[h2]Halloween Event[/h2]

• We added a fun Pumpkin Mode for Conquest and Team Deathmatch. Pumpkins shall be destroyed!
• The Nisida map received its Halloween makeup. Additionally, all other PvP maps and the Expedition map will feature Halloween attributes during the event.
• For completing Halloween tasks you will receive some cool Halloween skins and a Halloween trinket. The skins are available for the following weapons:
• • Zenith automatic rifle.
• • Firespray submachine gun.
• • G5 Earl pistol.
• • Impala sniper rifle.
• • M2 Tactical SAS shotgun.
• A cool Halloween-themed loading screen and lobby music to get you into a nice Halloween mood.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

• The way Ram's Gravity Strike works changed. To use the gravity strike to its maximum power, it needs to be "charged" for up to one second by holding the fire button (the charging circle indicator appears in the center of the screen) and then releasing it. You may use the ability by just triggering the fire button: it will still work, but its power will be much lower.
• Orbit's Detector Drone got some tuning:
• • Its movement became more realistic.
• • We improved its behavior so the chances that it may lose its owner decreased considerably.
• •  It no longer detects traps. It can only detect other players now.
• • The drone's scanning time (when it hovers over an enemy player) was reduced to 1 second while the scanning radius was increased.
• • In addition to that, the drone's visuals were improved. 
• The bomb timer was reduced from 60 to 40 seconds in Demolition mode.
• • Respawn time in Conquest was reduced from 8 to 5 seconds.

[h3]Weapon balance changes[/h3]:
• XM-40 Conciliator assault rifle:
• • Significantly increased precision shot effective distance.
• • Slightly increased precision shot damage.
• U44 Culverina revolver:
• • Decreased accuracy.
• • Increased precision effective distance but decreased precision shot damage at very long ranges.
• U22 Svarog revolver:
• • Decreased accuracy.
• • Slightly decreased base damage but the number of bullets to kill remains the same.
• • Decreased precision shot effective distance.
• Svarog Cossack legendary modification's "Cowboy Reflexes" perk (For a short time after weapon selection, the first bullet fired will deal double damage):
• • The perk time was decreased to 2 seconds.
• • Decreased accuracy when the perk is active.  
• • The perk cannot be activated by using melee now.
• AI-s: Based on your feedback, we've made some tweaks to AI-s to make the game more challenging.

[h2]Expedition[/h2]

• Map optimization and improvements (in particular, terrain bumps where players could stumble over were removed). Improved visual effects.
• New encounter: Phantom Core.
• New perks:
• • Blast Armor (Armored vest tailored to resist significant amounts of damage from explosions).
• • Kinetic Armor (Armored vest tailored to resist moderate amounts of damage from kinetic projectiles such as bullets).
• • CQB Armor (Armored vest tailored to resist moderate amounts of damage from melee attacks).
• The time to reconnect back into the mission and away-from-keyboard kick timer were increased to 120 seconds in Expedition.
• Fixed bug when the Supply Bin failed to open.
• Fixed bug that when the item rarity chances failed to increase after the 3rd encounter.
• The rarity for the Strife and the Feedback Loop perks was increased (from epic to legendary for Strife and from rare to epic for Feedback Loop).


[h2]Maps/Modes[/h2]

• Sunken Lab PvE episode and Hardcore Demolition mode were added to events rotation.


[h2]UI[/h2]

• The Blueprints' limit is now visualized properly on the Crafting screen.
• The Operatives progression screen was overhauled to match the design of other lobby screens.
• The Armory's accuracy bar values for handguns were tweaked for the accuracy bar to better represent differences between handguns.
• Store bundles now show their content in a list (it was done by text only previously). Additionally, the bundle's rarity is indicated above the bundle name. 

[h2]Store[/h2]

• We added the option to buy Season Pass levels for Premium Pass owners.
• New items in the Store:
• • A legendary bundle containing Kite's Shadow Warrior suit and Shadow Warrior mask.
• • A headgear bundle containing Brisa's unisex haircut, Ram's skydiver glasses, Mongoose's fireman helmet, and Kite's armored headphones.
• • Brisa weapon sticker.
• • Stiletto Heel weapon trinket.
• •  Weapon Adorn bundle: the Baseball Bat trinket and the Glasshead sticker.
• • Operative paints box where you can get a random item among Kite's orange sniper vest, Kite's orange sniper pants, Mongoose's olive assault vest, Mongoose's olive assault pants, Pill's swampy brown vest, Pill's swampy brown pants, Ram's desert storm vest, and Ram's desert storm pants.
• •  A box with a random weapon skin.
(You will get a different item every time you purchase a box)
• For in-game currency purchases, we added support for the following currencies: Australian dollar (AUD), British Pound Sterling (GBP), Brazilian real (BRL), Canadian dollar (CAD), Euro (EUR), Japanese yen (JPY), and Ukrainian hryvnia (UAH). 

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]

• Pill's Quantum Nullifier ability was moved from the slot occupied by Med Drone to the Stasis Field Grenade slot.
• Three new instant awards: for killing a Chaser, for planting a bomb, and for defusing a bomb.
• We fixed the wrong AI hitbox position when the AI was affected by the Satis Field grenade.
• Animation improvements:
• • Updated crouch animation in third-person view.
• • Improved weapon switch animation.
• • Improved animation of the U44 Culverina and the U22 Svarog revolvers when aiming down sights.
• • Improved weapon inspection animation of the U22 Svarog revolver, the Berlington TAC shotgun, and the Presarm VX-7 sniper rifle.
• Improved visuals of all scope attachments:
• • The visual gap between the lens and the eyepiece was removed.
• • Better shine and reflections on the eyepiece glass.
• We improved the graphics quality for the existing graphical settings. Some players may see a drop in their frame rates for the same graphical settings they used previously. It depends on your graphics card. If this is the case, you need to lower your graphical settings to up the performance.
• The Intro mission underwent optimization.

notes.title: Update R66
notes.content:
[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
• Animation improvements for the [i]G5 Earl[/i] pistol and the [i]SAG-8 Reaper[/i] sniper rifle.
• Lots of audio improvements.
• Performance improvements.


[h2]STORE[/h2][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YKjq8yNhzPmNF6Sk33/giphy.gif[/img]

• A new Premium Founder's Pack featuring:
• • Shellguard battle suit for all operatives.
• • Kite's Avenger blindfold, Simulation interface, and Cyborg helmet.
• • Malva's Extravagant eyeguard and Extravagant haircut.
• • Mongoose's Sensei beard and Kevlar helmet.
• • Ram's Shellguard visor and Skull helmet.
• • Brisa's Indigenous haircut and Simulation interface.
• • Orbit's Digital monocle, Half-Helmet, and Simulation interface.
• • Pill's Beanie hat and Robo-mask.
• • Strix's Tacticool haircut and Stratospheric helmet.
• • Weapon skins: TAC Magma, Pacifier Semiconductor, Drachen Stone Cold, Earl Ember, and Impala Infernal.
• • Weapon trinkets: Сartridge, Magma ball, Gasoline canister, Stone cold, and Lantern.

• Owners of the non-premium Founder's Pack can buy a premium one with a discount (the discounted price is 3,500 coins, taking into account the initial founder's pack price of 2,500).

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]Weapon tweaks[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GJ8VlvdIPghfDM6jIR/giphy-downsized.gif[/img]

• Shotguns:
• • In a lot of feedback about shotguns, players were concerned that shotguns were useless at mid-range. We agree: no damage at all at mid-range was strange, so now shotguns do deal small damage at mid-range.
• • [i]Side Note[/i]: Overall, the shotgun is the most controversial weapon for the community in any FPS game, Shatterline being no exception. Thus another major part of the feedback was about shotguns being overpowered. We did our best to find any corroboration to that in our data, but alas, we found no proof of that theory. In any case, we are closely monitoring the situation with shotguns and will react accordingly if we find any imbalance proof in our data, including the impact of today's change in damage at mid-range.

• [i]R21 Brute [/i]shotgun: fixed issues with incorrect damage.

• [i]R60 Gevaudan[/i] shotgun:
• • stability was decreased by approximately 10%.
• • slightly decreased rate of fire.

• Bolt-action sniper rifles:
• • One shot kill to the head, neck, chest, shoulders, and upper arms.
• • No one shot kill to the belly, legs, and lower arms.

• [i]Presarm VX-7[/i] sniper rifle:
• • greatly decreased stability.
• • decreased precision damage at long range.
• • slightly decreased effective precision damage distance.

• [i]Dragonfly [/i]sniper rifle:
• • increased precision damage at effective range.
• • decreased precision damage at long range.

• [i]Impala [/i]sniper rifle: decreased precision damage at long range.

• [i]TWD X-Treme[/i] sniper rifle:
• • slightly decreased aiming speed.
• • slightly decreased stability.

• [i]SAG-8 Reaper[/i] sniper rifle: slightly decreased aiming speed.

• [i]Zenith [/i]automatic rifle:
• • reworked recoil pattern
• • stability was decreased by around 10%
• • precision damage was decreased for very long distances
• • decreased precision damage effective distance.

• [i]Cinetech M5[/i] submachine gun:
• • reworked recoil pattern
• • stability was decreased by around 10%.

• [i]Drachen [/i]submachine gun: slightly decreased overall effective damage distance.

• [i]Lupara Compatta[/i] pistol:  decreased effective damage distance.

• [i]TAC Spiderweb[/i] shotgun legendary modification:  has 6 shotshells in a clip now.

• [i]VX-7 Santa Muerte[/i] sniper rifle legendary modification: damage effect was decreased from +100% to +50% and duration was decreased to 5 sec.

• [i]Drachen Racer[/i] submachine gun: now the buff applies only after a precision kill, not any kill as before.

• Attachments:
• • [i]RAINBOW-G[/i] grip for the Impala sniper rifle: stability buff was decreased to 15%.
• • [i]GVLK Scope[/i] for the Impala sniper rifle: stability buff was decreased to 10%.
• • [i]Tantalus Red[/i] laser scope for the TWD X-Treme sniper rifle: the buff was changed to increased precision damage by 15%.
• • [i]GB-45 Striker[/i] grip for the TWD X-Treme sniper rifle: fixed issues with incorrect moving speed values.
• •[i] PM PAW [/i]scope for the TWD X-Treme sniper rifle: 35% stability decrease debuff was added. 

   
[h3]Megaheads PvP Event[/h3]
• The minimum head size was decreased while the maximum head size was increased.
• The head size doesn't reset at respawn.
• The head size is depicted on HUD.
 
[h3]Other[/h3]

• New movable vehicles on the[i] Old Town[/i] PvP map.
• Malva won't receive a score for self-healing anymore.
• To prevent slide abuse, we added slide speed recovery time. During this time after the slide, you can still perform another one, but the starting speed will be much lower.
• Credit session rewards were increased.
• Ram's ultimate cooldown was increased by a third.

[h2]TASKS[/h2]

• New daily tasks for Conquest and Escort.
• Task tweaks:
• • The "[i]Outnumbered[/i]" task became easier. Instead of 5 kills with a primary weapon and 5 kills with a sidearm without dying in PvP, you now need to perform 4 and 2 kills without dying in PvP respectively.
• • The "[i]Stealth Mode[/i]" task condition was changed. Instead of killing an enemy with a precision shot while crouching in PvP, you now need to kill an enemy with a sidearm while crouching in PvP.

[h2]EXPEDITION[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qOp5r6pMPChlCZMqyn/giphy-downsized.gif[/img]

•  New encounter: [i]Power Stones[/i].
•  New perks
• • [i]Empowered Primary[/i] (Greatly increases damage after two kills. Resets on reload.)
• • [i]Empowered Sidearm[/i] (Greatly increases damage after a kill. Resets on reload)
• • [i]Freezing Touch[/i] (Gives a chance to freeze an enemy upon hit).
• • [i]Slide Bomber[/i] (Enemies explode when killed during or shortly after a slide).
• The number of concurrent Strafer shields was reduced from 3 to 2.

[h2]UI[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jPPkgOYf0QKrNpxFVs/giphy-downsized.gif[/img]

• The Operative Selection screen received a facelift and now looks in line with other menu screens.
• The new color scheme for attachment descriptions: improved parameter descriptions are now colored green while worsened are colored red.
• •The improved parameter descriptions for epic weapon modifications are colored yellow while legendary modifications are in magenta.
• Game tasks:
• • Game tasks were moved to the Season tab.
• • The game taskbar is now featured on the session's Play screen.
• Improved session result screen (don't forget you can skip some parts of it).
•  In the previous release there was a bug: all weapon modifications were shown in the Armory, not only those that were available for crafting this season. This was fixed: you will see only those modifications that are available in the crafting machine. If a weapon has no modifications in the crafting machine at the moment, the modification button will be disabled altogether.

[h2]IN-GAME SUPPORT TICKETS AND PLAYER REPORTING[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/zmZ40vwUnkFZsfz5oO/giphy-downsized.gif[/img]

• Now you can create a support ticket without exiting the game. Just click on the Support button, fill in the details, and send it to our Support Team. Nice and easy.
• We added an option to report other players for suspected cheating, exploit use, or offensive behavior. You can report a player both from the game session or from the game lobby.

[h2]CONTROLLERS[/h2]

• Aim Assist strength was considerably reduced.

[h2]OTHER[/h2]

• The game will ask your permission to collect telemetry data at the first launch of the updated game. Kindly consent since telemetry is essential for our development and balancing efforts.
• Fixed EAC kick for Linux anti-cheat module.
• Hundreds of bug fixes.

[previewyoutube=vyKOArKBuUE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 65.4 is LIVE
notes.content:
The patch is LIVE!

The crux of today’s update is the updated anti-cheat and changes in the Blueprint economy.

Anti-cheat update was our top priority as the abundant reports about cheaters in the game had us very worried. It took us some time to update it due to technical difficulties we had to overcome. 

And as promised, the crafting cost reduction has arrived. We’ve decreased the crafting cost to 300 Blueprints. We think this is a fair price, considering the game economy's intricacies.

“Why did it take you the whole week to come down with this critical change?” you may ask. Our key concern was to prevent a situation when some players would have enough Blueprints to craft a lot of new weapon modifications at the start of the next season. And we think we’ve found the middle ground: to ensure a level playing field for all players for each new season, we are introducing a limit on how many Blueprints players can accumulate without spending them on crafting. This limit is set to 700 (No worries: if you already amassed 700+ Blueprints, the difference won’t disappear. You can use all you have, but you won’t get more until you have spent some, and their number is below 700). Basically, it means that anyone will be able to craft a maximum of two weapon modifications off the bat at the start of a new season. To get more, you will have to earn them by playing. Kindly beware of the known issue: there is no UI visualization for the Blueprint accumulation cap. This issue will be fixed in Release 66 scheduled to come in a couple of weeks. 

We hope this change will kill two birds with one throw: less grinding to get weapon modifications and fair play in each new season. 

And another significant change is bug fixes for a number of game tasks. 

Let us once again express our gratitude for providing us with important feedback, indispensable in our efforts to make the game better!

Oh, and we added more server territories. 

See all the changes in the patch notes.

notes.title: We heard your feedback and have dealt with some pesky issues already
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to thank you for bringing the key issues with the game to our attention. 

[list]
[*] We are working hard to deal with the servers shortage issue, but unfortunately, it is taking longer than we expected. It’s a work in progress now. 
[*] There was an Encounter in Expedition that couldn’t be completed, and you had to restart the client. It has already been fixed in Live. 
[*] We agree that the Season Pass should get more progression points from game sessions. We have dramatically increased the season pass progression rewards from just completing a game session. The change is Live. Kindly check it in the game and share your feedback.
[*] We doubled the Expedition Blueprints rewards. The change is also Live, but the UI will still show you the old Blueprint rewards numbers. The UI discrepancy will be dealt with in a hotfix. 
[/list]

Please accept our apologies for any discomfort or frustration you have experienced because of these and other issues. We are doing everything possible and impossible to improve. Please understand that these are our first steps in the high seas of Shatterline live operations, our doing it by ourselves. We lack a publisher’s operations department, so the devs do everything by themselves. 

This situation has once again shown how important your feedback is. Thank you very much for being with us and doing an excellent job of improving the game. Togеther we will make this game a hit! 

We are also preparing a hotfix. This means we will need to shut down the servers for a couple of hours for maintenance tomorrow.

notes.title: Update R65: Early Access
notes.content:
[h1]R65 Release Notes - Early Access (September 8, 2022)[/h1]

Greetings, Shellguard! While you were playing on our playtests and waiting for Early Access, we were preparing a new game release for you. So here is the list of key changes.


[h2]Game Store[/h2]

The Game Store is now open for customers. For the Early Access launch, the variety of items is not staggering, but the items in the Store are worth checking out nonetheless:

[list]
[*] A Founder's Pack featuring 4 exclusive full-body suits for operatives, 4 exclusive skins and trinkets for weapons, and a nameplate with the Season Alpha theme. And a special Early Access price to boot.
[*] The Frag Lab trinket and the Shatterline rail cover. Buy them to support us.
[/list]

[h2]Season Pass[/h2]

A new Season Pass with Free and Premium ladders. Season Alpha will last for 12 weeks.

[h2]Balance and progression changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The number of experience points to level-up operatives was reduced for the playtests, so now we have increased them.
[*] The number of experience points to unlock new weapons and attachments also changed, as did the cost of unlocks.
[*] The number of experience points for weapon progression received in the Expedition mode was lowered.
[*] The order of weapon attachment progression was slightly changed.
[*] Crystalline Slide perk mechanics in Expedition were reworked, but the perk does feel the same.
[*] We increased the cost of crafting with Blueprints from 10 to 450. But don't be alerted by this as we also significantly increased the inflow of Blueprints in the game. The Blueprints can be obtained not only in Expedition, but also from Daily and Weekly Tasks as well as First win of the Day tasks in the Expedition mode, in Versus, and in Weekly Events. Furthermore, the number of Blueprints from completed tasks has increased considerably.
[*] The conditions of a plethora of tasks changed.
[*] The way how weekly tasks work also changed. Now seven weekly tasks are allocated each week during the Season. These tasks will stay for the whole season, allowing you to complete them at a later time throughout the Season (which will last, as mentioned earlier, for 12 weeks).
[/list]

[h3]Weapons rebalance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bolt-action sniper rifles will not deliver a one-shot kill in the upper extremities anymore.
[*] G7 Springer pistol:  the rate of fire decreased from 400 to 375 rounds per minute; reload speed increased by 0.1 seconds; and magazine capacity decreased by 1 bullet, so the magazine has 15 bullets now.
[*] R21 Brute shotgun: the recoil pattern changed; the effective fire distance increased by 1 meter.
[*] Dragonfly sniper rifle's magazine capacity increased from 10 to 14 rounds, while the extended magazine capacity of its modification also increased from 15 to 20 rounds.
[*] A lot of weapon attachments were rebalanced.
[/list]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]

[list]
[*] Some weapons now feature unique crosshairs.
[*] The list of weapon modifications available in the crafting machine was tweaked for Season Alpha. 
[*] The kill counter can now be used on any weapon.
[/list]

Some modifications available on the playtest were removed while new ones were added:
[list]
[*] Svarog Cossack. For a short time after weapon selection, the first bullet fired deals double damage.
[*] Legatus Bloodstream offers a 10% increase in aiming speed.
[*] Centurion Biplane offers a 10% increase in effective range.
[*] Springer Neon offers a 10% increase in hip fire accuracy when walking.
[*] Pacifier Neon offers a 12% increase in accuracy.
[*] Reaper Mural offers a 10% improvement in sway stability when aiming.
[/list]
  
[h2]Expedition[/h2]

[list]
[*] Here we do not have a lot of changes for you, but our best experts worked well on the visuals of the Expedition map. Apart from cosmetic improvements, we added some new points of interest you may want to check. And of course, some nasty bugs were fixed.
[*] The perks and contamination list has moved from the ESC-button screen to the TAB one. 
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] 
[*] The weapon modification screen has received a facelift and looks in line with other screens.
[/list]

[h2]Animation and visual effects[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved character movement animations on slopes (in third-person view).
[*] New Chaser AI animation in the Expedition mode.
[*] Tweaked Impala sniper rifle's position on the screen in the first-person view.
[*] Improved first-person animation for the Impala sniper rifle, the Earl sidearm, and the TAC Spiderweb shotgun.
[*] Improved Ram's dash ultimate ability trail visual effects as well as the Crystalline Slide perk effects in the Expedition mode.
[/list]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Enemy outlines won't be displayed in the kill cam. On the other hand, fallen friendlies will display an outline.
[*] Destructible doors physics improvement.
[*] Improved in-game camera movement when the player interacts with a usable object.
[*] Three different graphics options for shaders were merged into one - the Shading Quality.
[*] The pinging system was also improved: If a ping is made at a space in close proximity to the target, it is treated as a target ping. The pinging action is triggered when pressing the mouse button, not at release as it used to be. 
[*] Our August playtest participants will receive a unique weapon trinket to distinguish their early interest in Shatterline.  
[/list]

[h2]Is that all?[/h2]

No, this list of key changes is far from comprehensive. Our sound team will probably feel offended if we fail to mention that they did an excellent job fixing different sound issues and adding new cool sound effects.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bolt action rifles perform one-shot kills to any body part in the Shooting Range.
[*] Player hands may hang in the air during pistol reload animation.
[*] Weapon trinkets may shake unnaturally during side and backward movement, and at the beginning of a forward movement.
[*] The game client may freeze at the Play-of-the-Game replay.
[*] In the Intro mission, the play can get into a non-playable location and fall into the water (area after the zip line).
[*] The U22 SVAROG weapon progression level resets after every match in Expedition.
[*] A player can get an occasional "Connection 01-00 error".
[*] ARMALIBS RDS-4 scope for the Firespray smg may cause a freeze before shooting after zooming out.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest schedule update for Week 3 (Aug 22-28) and a new server in Singapore
notes.content:
Hi there!

We are changing this week’s playtest schedule (Week 3 of the playtest: Aug 22-28, 2022). Instead of three separate playtest days (Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday), we will conduct a 3-day non-stop play session from Tuesday to early Friday.

Therefore, this week’s play session will start on [i][b]August 23[/b][/i], 2022, at [b]17:00 CEST[/b] (11am EDT) and end on [i][b]August 26[/b][/i], 2022, at [b]08:00 CEST [/b](2am EDT). 

Additionally, we are expanding VERSUS with the Conquest mode. Thus, VERSUS will now feature Escort, Team Deathmatch, and Conquest. 

And another good news: we are opening a new server in [b]Singapore [/b]to improve the game experience for our players from Asia. 

As always, access to download the game will be provided 6 hours before the playtest start.

notes.title: Release Notes R64 (Playtest)
notes.content:
[h2]RELEASE NOTES[/h2]

We’ve developed four major releases since the suspension of our community play sessions in April and now we are a native “Coming Soon” Steam game with no more awkward game launchers or confusing registration process.

Let’s cut to the chase and see what key changes Releases 61-64 have brought.
 
[b]SEASON PASS[/b]

We’ve added a long awaited Season Pass into our game.The test season features 43 levels.

[b]WEAPONS[/b]

New weapon modifications:
[list]
[*] Lupara Mitica legendary pistol. Gameplay buff is coming soon.
[*] Impala Starfall epic sniper rifle has an increased effective damage distance by 12%.
[*] TAC Antique epic shotgun has an increased damage to the head by 10%.
[*] Zenith Deep Space epic assault rifle has an increased damage to the head by 7%.
[*] Earl Mural epic pistol, with a decreased spread by 10%.
[/list]

Weapon tweaks:
[list]
[*] Tweaked first-person position and recoil feel of selected assault rifles (XM-40 Conciliator, XM-27 Pacifier, and Zenith).
[*] All assault rifles: decreased movement speed while aiming down sights by 10%.
[*] XM-27 Pacifier assault rifle (Tier 1): slightly reduced damage to the head.
[*] Λ-3 Pilum assault rifle (Tier 3): increased delay between bursts.
[*] Λ-9 Legatus assault rifle (Tier 5): increased rate of fire.
[*] All submachine guns: decreased damage at medium range by 15% on average, new recoil patterns.
[*] Z-940 Drachen submachine gun (Tier 1): slightly increased damage at effective distance and decreased damage at long distances.
[*] Cinetech M5 submachine gun (Tier 2): slightly decreased damage to the head; slightly increased damage at effective distance and decreased damage at long distance.
[*] Firespray submachine gun (Tier 3): increased damage to the head; slightly increased damage at effective distance. Default and extended magazines capacity was increased by 2 bullets.
[*] Λ-1 Centurion submachine gun (Tier 4): slightly increased effective distance.
[*] Tornado submachine gun (Tier 5): new and more accurate hip fire spread; slightly increased effective distance.
[*] M2 Tactical SAS shotgun (Tier 3): the rate of fire increased by over 57%.
[*] R21 Brute shotgun (Tier 5): increased rate of fire and increased accuracy.
[*] Dragonfly sniper rifle (Tier 4): the rate of fire increased by over 63%.
[*] TWD X-Treme sniper rifle (Tier 3): slightly decreased base and headshot damage; decreased stability.
[*] SAG-8 Reaper sniper rifle (Tier 5): slightly decreased base damage, headshot damage, and piercing ability; increased zoom-in and reloading speed; increased stability.
[/list]

Legendary modifications’ perks:
[list]
[*] Pacifier Crusader legendary assault rifle: reloading the gun when you are at full health provides an increased rate of fire for one magazine. On perk’s activation you will see a visual feedback on the weapon. As expected, an increased rate of fire has a different sound to it.
[*] Centurion Perforator legendary submachine gun: reloading after two kills increases the rate of fire for 6 seconds. On perk’s activation you will see a visual feedback on the weapon.
[*] Earl Samurai legendary pistol: melee kills when holding the pistol restore a portion of health.
[*] VX-7 Santa Muerte legendary sniper rifle: deals double damage for a moderate duration after a headshot, but doesn’t have an increased rate of fire as before. We also added visual feedback on perks’s activation and a different sound effect for the buffed shots.
[*] Drachen Racer legendary submachine gun: Sprint/Dash cooldown is reset upon kill (applicable to Orbit, Mongoose, Strix, and Ram).
[*] M5 Joker legendary submachine gun: the ammo is fed from backpack directly to chamber for a short duration after kill. We added a visual and audio feedback on perk's activation.
[*] Black Falcon Cyber legendary shotgun: the ammo is being gradually reloaded into magazine when you are sprinting.
[*] Svarog Cossack legendary pistol: for a short time after weapon selection, the first bullet deals double damage. Visual feedback for perk’s activation and special sound for the buffed shot were added.
[/list]

Attachment tweaks:
[list]
[*] Flash-bang ammo for the Lupara Compatta pistol: increased flash duration and decreased flashing range.
[*] SULAKO SP5 silencer for the U44 Culverina pistol: increased damage drop at long range.
[*] Warmonger parametric attachment for the Λ-9 Legatus assault rifle: Double kills instead of Rampage instant award increase weapon aiming speed by 30%, decrease hip spread by 50%, and reduce recoil by 30% for 10 seconds.
[/list]

Additional Weapon Changes:
[list]
[*] Updated weapon descriptions in the menu.
[*] The crosshairs of all pistols except the two-barrel Lupara Compatta (Tier 3) change their shape dynamically as feedback to pistol’s rate of fire and recoil.
[*] Some weapon cosmetics categories (rail patches, stickers, trinkets) can only be applied to one weapon at the same time.
[*] Tweaks in weapon tiers unlock cost (57% less for Tier 2, 10% more for Tier 3, and 5% more for Tier 4).
[*] Increased initial weapon attachments unlock speed.
[*] A kill counter was introduced to all Tier 1 weapons. It is Level 13 weapon progression unlock reward.
[*] Weapon suppressors now heat up and glow hot red at continuous shooting.
[/list]
 
[b]GAME MECHANICS[/b]
[list]
[*] High climb improvement: if you are performing a high climb and hit an obstacle, the climb is interrupted.
[*] The movable car’s physics became more realistic.
[*] We added some weapon inertia in first-person view when the character raises or lowers their sight.
[/list]
 
[b]GAME PARTY (SQUAD)[/b]
[list]
[*] If you are in a party, only your party leader can decide what the party shall do after the session end. The leader can choose to play again or leave to the lobby, and the decision affects everyone in the party. Of course, party members can choose to leave the party at session end.
[*] We introduced a new Player and Party Status widget in the top right corner, showing the player’s info along with their party members.
[*] Party members are displayed as avatars. And the party leader can be distinguished by the crown icon on top of the avatar.
[*] By clicking your own avatar, you will get an option to leave the current party.
[*] By clicking on any party member or an empty party member slot you will be shown a menu with such categories as My Squad, Friend Requests, My Friends, and Recent Players, along with a search field (Windows Ctrl+V combination is supported). 
[*]  Clicking on a player will open the Player Info menu.
[/list]

[b]USER INTERFACE / MENU / HUD[/b]

[list]
[*] The Armory screen got a facelift according to the new general UI design.
[*] If you press the Esc button when in any main screen except “Play” (Tasks, Operatives, Armory, Crafting, Store, or Inbox), you will move to the Play screen. When in the Play Screen, pressing the Escape will open the confirmation window to quit the game.
[*] We improved the readability of objective icons. When they superimpose on one another, the farther icon increases its opacity, thus making the one in front easier to identify.
[*] We also improved readability of the weapon attachment tooltip: bonus descriptions are now bullet pointed and in accented color. 
[*] The Task Panel in the Play Menu shows 5 most progressed tasks.
[*] On the Character Customization screen, the camera now zooms in and out the chosen customization part of the body: the head, the upper body, or the lower body.
[*] We introduced a new game session Summary Screen showing your rewards, unlocks, and scoreboard in three tabs.
[*] The game session result screen may now show more information than the result itself (victory, defeat, or draw), providing additional information on player’s place, Expedition related stats, etc.
[/list]

[b]MAPS/MODES[/b]

ESCORT MODE:
[list]
[*] Bomb Dogs spawning from the Escort Wagon can now be killed when airborne.
[*] Additional time for each checkpoint was decreased by 20 sec.
[*] Initial attackers and defenders’ spawn points are now protected by a kill zone for the opposing team.
[*] Tweaked spawn points.
[/list]

EXPEDITION MODE:
[list]
[*] Expedition features fewer encounters and perks you used to see before the pause in playtests. We’ll add new encounters and perks periodically.
[*] Level tweaks and polishing.
[*] Encounters tweaks.
[*] Modifiers: The Lightning Anomaly has a new visual, while its damage and distance were tweaked.
[*] Mode-specific Victory and Defeat Screens.
[/list]

CQB and Death Lab PvP maps:
[list]
[*] Spawn points tweaks.
[*] Tweaks in positions of visual helpers (climbs, ziplines, etc).
[/list]

The Intro Mission:
[list]
[*] The Intro Mission now onboards the player how to change a weapon mid-game.
[*] The Intro Mission starts up automatically when you launch the game for the first time. At further launches, it won’t auto-start even if you haven’t completed it.
[*] Performance optimization.
[/list]
 
[b]CHARACTERS[/b]
[list]
[*] The headgear has become a separate item in the legendary character outfits. Thus, you may apply a legendary headgear item with other body items. Alternatively, you can change the headgear in your legendary outfit.
[*] New character cosmetics items.
[/list]

Character progression:
[list]
[*] The maximum level of character progression was set to 8.
[*] Orbit’s progression rewards were resetup.
[*] Rewards were revisited for almost all missions / game modes.
[*] Abilities for Level 8 character progression:
[*] * Pill: Projectile destroyer
[*] * Malva: Medi-spray
[*] * Kite: Claymore
[*] * Brisa: Shock charge
[*] * Mongoose: Flashbang grenade
[*] * Strix: Fire wave grenade
[*] * Ram: Explosive axe
[/list]

ABILITIES:
[list]
[*] Mongoose now has a leap ability activated by the SHIFT key. He leaps 3 meters forward. Cooldown: 5 seconds. Available at Level 1 of character progression.
[*] Ram’s axe now has a bleeding effect, making it more efficient against beefy AIs.
[/list]

[b]OTHER[/b]:
[list]
[*] We’ve performed a lot of tweaks and improvements to optimize game performance. Additionally, tons of various animation, texture, visual effects, and audio improvements and fixes have been introduced, including sprint-related animation bug fixes.
[*] We’ve got a gorgeous new loading screen.
[*] The Play of the Game feature was improved in terms of better timings.
[*] After the game session, if you don’t press anything, the Play Again button will get activated automatically when the timer displayed on it is over. You can always abort the matchmaking for the next match by pressing the Cancel button.
[/list]

New instant rewards:
[list]
[*] “Theseus” for killing a Minotaur in melee.
[*] “Axe in the skull” for kills with an axe (3 kills in PvP and 1 in PvE).
[*] “Trust me” for non-lethal abilities use (2 uses in PvP and 5 in PvE).
[*] “Slide kill” for 3 slide kills in PvE.
[/list]

By clicking on any party member or an empty party member slot you will be shown a menu with such categories as My Squad, Friend Requests, My Friends, and Recent Players, along with a search field (Windows Ctrl+V combination is supported).
Clicking on a player will open the Player Info menu.
The Armory screen got a facelift according to the new general UI design.

tags.bug: If you press the Esc button when in any main screen except “Play” (Tasks, Operatives, Armory, Crafting, Store, or Inbox), you will move to the Play screen. When in the Play Screen, pressing the Escape will open the confirmation window to quit the game.
We improved the readability of objective icons. When they superimpose on one another, the farther icon increases its opacity, thus making the one in front easier to identify.
We also improved readability of the weapon attachment tooltip: bonus descriptions are now bullet pointed and in accented color.

tags.feature: The Task Panel in the Play Menu shows 5 most progressed tasks.
On the Character Customization screen, the camera now zooms in and out the chosen customization part of the body: the head, the upper body, or the lower body.
We introduced a new game session Summary Screen showing your rewards, unlocks, and scoreboard in three tabs.
The game session result screen may now show more information than the result itself (victory, defeat, or draw), providing additional information on player’s place, Expedition related stats, etc.

tags.balance_change: Bomb Dogs spawning from the Escort Wagon can now be killed when airborne.
Additional time for each checkpoint was decreased by 20 sec.
Initial attackers and defenders’ spawn points are now protected by a kill zone for the opposing team.
Tweaked spawn points.
Expedition features fewer encounters and perks you used to see before the pause in playtests. We’ll add new encounters and perks periodically.
Level tweaks and polishing.
Encounters tweaks.
Modifiers: The Lightning Anomaly has a new visual, while its damage and distance were tweaked.
Mode-specific Victory and Defeat Screens.
Spawn points tweaks.
Tweaks in positions of visual helpers (climbs, ziplines, etc).

tags.feature: The Intro Mission now onboards the player how to change a weapon mid-game.

tags.bug: The Intro Mission starts up automatically when you launch the game for the first time. At further launches, it won’t auto-start even if you haven’t completed it.

tags.balance_change: Performance optimization.

tags.feature: The headgear has become a separate item in the legendary character outfits. Thus, you may apply a legendary headgear item with other body items. Alternatively, you can change the headgear in your legendary outfit.
New character cosmetics items.

tags.balance_change: The maximum level of character progression was set to 8.
Orbit’s progression rewards were resetup.
Rewards were revisited for almost all missions / game modes.

tags.feature: Abilities for Level 8 character progression: * Pill: Projectile destroyer * Malva: Medi-spray * Kite: Claymore * Brisa: Shock charge * Mongoose: Flashbang grenade * Strix: Fire wave grenade * Ram: Explosive axe
Mongoose now has a leap ability activated by the SHIFT key. He leaps 3 meters forward. Cooldown: 5 seconds. Available at Level 1 of character progression.

tags.balance_change: Ram’s axe now has a bleeding effect, making it more efficient against beefy AIs.

tags.bug: We’ve performed a lot of tweaks and improvements to optimize game performance. Additionally, tons of various animation, texture, visual effects, and audio improvements and fixes have been introduced, including sprint-related animation bug fixes.

tags.feature: We’ve got a gorgeous new loading screen.

tags.balance_change: The Play of the Game feature was improved in terms of better timings.

tags.bug: After the game session, if you don’t press anything, the Play Again button will get activated automatically when the timer displayed on it is over. You can always abort the matchmaking for the next match by pressing the Cancel button.

tags.feature: “Theseus” for killing a Minotaur in melee.
“Axe in the skull” for kills with an axe (3 kills in PvP and 1 in PvE).
“Trust me” for non-lethal abilities use (2 uses in PvP and 5 in PvE).
“Slide kill” for 3 slide kills in PvE.
